jobs.title: Global Investigator (EMEA)
jobs.description:
Global Investigator (EMEA)

Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

As a Global Investigator on the triage team, you will be the first line of operational defense in a fast-moving crypto disruption pipeline. You will process inbound complaint data, validate outputs from our artificial-intelligence (AI) investigation platform, and route cases into the investigative pipelines that result in frozen scam proceeds and seized assets. You will hold the disposition pen: your call is what turns a complaint into a freeze, a takedown, a recovery handoff, a legal-process draft, a victim notification, or a close.

The impact you will have:

  • Validate and route hundreds of complaint dispositions per week, feeding a live asset-recovery pipeline.

  • Catch the AI errors that matter, such as false positives, merged syndicates, and misclassified scam patterns, before they propagate downstream.

  • Enrich complaint selectors using a stack of more than forty commercial data-source integrations.

  • Take the highest-priority complaints beyond disposition: trace funds through consolidation wallets to regulated exchanges or other actionable endpoints

  • Own clean shift handoffs so the around-the-clock operation never drops a lead, providing EMEA-hours coverage that keeps the queue moving while colleagues in other regions are offline.

What we’re looking for:

  • 4 or more years of investigative or analytical experience in the public or private sector, including hands-on blockchain analysis.

  • Demonstrated experience tracing funds across chains and attributing addresses to real-world actors, including the judgment to tell an unattributed service from a privately controlled (unhosted) wallet

  • Experience building or contributing to cases that led to a freeze, seizure, arrest, or takedown.

  • Strong AI fluency, meaning comfort using AI tools as a daily co-pilot, plus the judgment to know when they are wrong.

  • Comfort operating in a fast-paced, fluid environment where the project's scope and emphasis may shift quarter to quarter.

  • Strong written and verbal communication.

About the Team:

  • The team is built around a mix of seasoned investigators and rising talent. Triage investigators sit alongside experienced crypto tracers and intelligence-trained individual contributors.

Team Operating Rhythms:

  • Daily schedule: standard business hours in your local time zone.

  • Collaboration: coordinate with global teammates for handoffs on time-sensitive items, giving the wider operation near follow-the-sun coverage.

On-Call Responsibilities:

  • Formal on-call rotation for high-priority events, such as hacks, law-enforcement support, and other time-sensitive matters.

  • Weekly rotation, with occasional weekend coverage as needed.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

  • React quickly to incoming complaint surges and live takedown events.

  • Continuously learn new patterns in crypto-enabled crime.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

  • Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

  • Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

Privacy Policy and Additional Information

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.

Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law.

If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at privacy@trmlabs.com.

To notify TRM Labs that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

The use of AI tools of any kind (including but not limited to notetakers, interview assistants, and real-time coaching tools such as Otter.ai, Fireflies, Fathom, Cluey, or similar) during TRM interviews is not permitted without prior approval from TRM. TRM uses its own internal tools for note-taking to ensure a consistent and confidential experience for all candidates.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this form.

Recruitment agencies

TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to TRM employees. TRM Labs is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company without a signed agreement.

Senior Functional Safety Engineer

About Us

Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is a joint venture between two industry leaders with a clear vision for automotive’s next chapter. Role Summary

Join a motivating team of experts developing Electric Vehicle technology through innovative zonal architecture development.

This position is based in our Berlin office and operates on a hybrid model, requiring at least three days per week on-site.

Responsibilities

  • Establish and continuously improve the processes and technical pipelines that collect, organize, and present all traceable evidences required for Functional Safety release or sign-off reports (production and SW releases) across all FuSa domains (Dynamics, Body, Thermal, Energy, ADAS, Core).

  • Define quantitative, evidence-based release criteria for FuSa sign-off — including thresholds for requirement verification coverage, safety mechanism test pass rates, diagnostic coverage metrics, ASIL-graded open-issue limits, and residual risk acceptance.

  • Work closely with PMT to align FuSa maturity criteria to program milestones and gate reviews, providing per-domain risk profiles that surface gaps in evidence completeness and drive early visibility of domains at risk of missing gate criteria.

  • Coordinate with FuSa domain leads, test automation, SW FuSa, HW FuSa, and PMT to align evidence deliverables against release schedules, driving pipeline efficiency so that sign-off can be given with confidence and minimal overhead on technical teams.

  • Develop and maintain automated dashboarding that consolidates release readiness, requirement coverage, open safety issues, and post-release fleet safety performance — enabling data-driven release decisions and continuous calibration of release criteria over successive programs.

  • Establish and track post-release safety performance indicators — including field failure rates against safety mechanism assumptions and safety-relevant DTC rates — to close the loop between pre-release evidence confidence and real-world outcomes.

  • Coordinate with external suppliers and Brand partners to collect, validate, and integrate supplier-generated safety work products and SEooC arguments into the vehicle-level safety case.

  • Work closely with the FuSa Process team and VWG Central FuSi process team to ensure release processes align with ISO 26262 compliance expectations across Rivian and VW programs.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Degree in Electrical/Electronic, Mechanical, Software, Systems, or Computer Engineering (or similar).

  • Over 5 years of experience in the automotive industry (or equivalent), ideally at an OEM or Tier 1, with at least 2 years in functional safety, systems engineering, or release/program engineering roles.

  • Proven knowledge of ISO 26262, particularly around work product management, confirmation reviews, safety case argumentation, and evidence-based release assessment.

  • Strong experience with requirements management and traceability tools (e.g. JAMA, DOORS) and issue tracking tools (e.g. Jira, Confluence).

  • Experience defining quantitative release criteria and safety performance metrics, and building reporting pipelines or dashboards to track them.

  • Experience with data visualization tools (e.g. Databricks, Tableau, Power BI); ability to present risk and safety performance metrics to technical and leadership audiences.

  • Good understanding of vehicle system functionality across multiple domains.

  • Excellent organizational and coordination skills; ability to drive cross-functional alignment under tight release schedules.

  • Good interpersonal and communication skills; ability to report clearly and concisely to senior management.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with supplier safety artifact management — SEooC arguments and supplier-provided safety cases integrated into a vehicle-level safety argument.

  • Exposure to fleet monitoring, field quality data, or post-release safety performance tracking.

  • Familiarity with CI/CD concepts and data pipeline tooling; scripting ability (e.g. Python) a plus.

Docplanner's mission is to help people live longer, healthier lives. Every month about 100 million people visit our sites and 25 million appointments are booked across 13 countries, and 300,000 doctors use our software (docplanner.com).

You'll join PMS Global, the group building the software clinics and doctors run on. We're building Noa, our AI assistant, into the daily work of doctors and front desks. The group is organised in verticals named after the people they serve: the doctor running a visit, the owner running the business, the practice signing up on its own.

The design team here is small and growing. As its Lead designer, you'll set the standard others work to and help the team grow.

The role

You'll own the design of an area of our practice management software (PMS), the tools clinics use every day to run visits, calendars and the business. You'll set design direction across the teams in that area and shape how it fits with the rest of the product. You'll help decide whether something is worth building, and why, before anyone decides how. This is an individual contributor role.

We want clinics to spend less time on manual work, from documenting a visit to getting it invoiced and paid, and owners to see what needs their attention without digging through reports.

What success looks like

  • After 3 months: you've been shipping since your first weeks, you can name the outcomes your area should move and the user behaviours behind them (where clinic staff lose time, work around the product or drop off), and you and product agree on the bigger problems worth solving. Clinics already feel it: your first fixes save front desks and doctors time on everyday tasks.

For clinics this means less manual admin and fewer workarounds; for doctors, more time with patients and less time on the screen; for owners, a clearer view of how the practice is doing.

What you'll do

  • Discover continuously: talk to doctors, clinic owners and staff often, whatever project you're on.

  • Drive clarity from complexity: balance user and business needs in areas like billing, records and reporting, and turn ambiguous problems into clear, strategic solutions.

  • Co-create with PMs and engineers from day one: define UX requirements early, stay through QA and release, and make engineering-aware decisions.

  • Shape high-leverage experiences: exceptional UI and UX for information-dense screens, from concept to polish, using the best tools to explore more directions faster and raise quality.

  • Prototype and build with AI: use Cursor and Claude Code to turn concepts into interactive prototypes and production-ready front-end code; move fluidly between code and Figma.

  • Validate and measure: run quick tests and track funnels, adoption and retention.

  • Lead without managing: set direction across teams, coach designers, and turn what works into patterns and practices others reuse.

What you bring

  • Multi-disciplinary craft: strong UI, UX and visual design skills, with a track record of functional yet delightful experiences in information-dense, data-heavy products, ideally B2B SaaS. You write clear interface copy and can tell the story behind a design.

  • Comfortable in code: you prototype in code with AI tools and know enough HTML and CSS to work with engineers on the front end. You don't need to be a front-end engineer.

  • Experimentation mindset: a deep understanding of product metrics, behaviour analytics and A/B testing, and experience with Amplitude, Mixpanel or similar tools. Your portfolio shows experiments and measurable outcomes.

  • Team spirit: generous, backs the best idea, hands-on, reliable, honest and transparent.

  • Lead-level scope: you've shaped direction across several teams or products, and other designers have grown by working with you.

  • Proficient English.

Design and AI at Docplanner

AI is changing how products are designed and built. We want our designers to explore how AI can improve both the design process and the product, from faster prototyping to Noa, the assistant inside our clinic software. We're looking for designers who are curious about new technology and experiment with AI in their own work. jobs.title: Principal Thermo-Mechanical Engineer- Paris/Grenoble
jobs.description:
Principal Thermo-Mechanical Engineer- Paris/Grenoble

About Us

We are building Physics AI for hardware design. Our software platform helps hardware designers and physics simulation engineers explore, analyze, and optimize hardware systems, leveraging cutting-edge AI to deliver ultrafast, accurate physics intelligence within the realities of engineering design workflows.

Our first product bridges the gap between the accuracy & determinism of traditional simulation and the speed & scaling of AI, and is redefining how the world’s most advanced semiconductors are designed, verified, built, brought to market and integrated in complex systems.

Role Overview

As a pivotal leader within our European Forward Deployment team, you will drive the adoption of Vinci’s platform among the region's top engineering organizations. In this strategic role, you will build, mentor, and guide a high-performing team of thermal engineers dedicated to engaging prospective customers and demonstrating our software's transformative value.

As trusted technical advisors, you and your team will use deep simulation expertise to help enterprise customers validate and optimize complex, real-world designs. Through these collaborative engagements, you will champion Vinci's value proposition by showing how our platform delivers systemic improvements in thermal performance, product reliability, and time-to-market.

Leveraging strong fundamentals in continuum mechanics, you will guide analyses of complex physical phenomena, including linear, geometric and material nonlinearities, and contact interactions. Your team will evaluate critical factors such as warpage, stress evolution, thermal cycling, and reliability across advanced semiconductor devices, electronics packages, and wafer-scale systems.

You will work closely with customer engineering teams to understand their technical challenges, provide expert guidance, and clearly articulate Vinci’s capabilities in solving real-world problems. You will also serve as a key feedback channel to product and engineering teams, translating customer insights into actionable inputs that shape product direction and drive continuous improvement.

This is a remote role, with close collaboration with Sales, Product, and Engineering in Palo Alto, CA, USA. The role includes moderate travel, primarily within continental Europe. Some infrequent intercontinental travel may be required for discussions and collaboration with the US team.

Responsibilities

  • Build, lead, and scale a high-performing team of thermo-mechanical engineers, setting the technical direction, hiring, mentoring team members, and driving field execution across Europe.

  • Collaborate closely with the sales team to lead technical discussions, scope proof-of-concept (PoC) evaluations, and deliver compelling product demonstrations to prospective enterprise customers.

  • Guide customer engineering teams through the evaluation phase by overseeing simulation setup, running complex test cases, and interpreting results to explicitly prove Vinci’s technical and business value.

  • Own customer enablement through onboarding, deployment pipeline and account expansion, providing senior technical guidance, structured training sessions, and advanced troubleshooting.

  • Provide product guidance and feedback, identify customer pain points and workflow bottlenecks, partnering directly with internal product and engineering teams to transform field feedback into critical new product features.

  • Represent Vinci at major industry conferences and semiconductor events, engaging technically with key prospects and partners through technical presentations and live platform demonstrations.

  • Maintain a strong understanding of competitive technologies, industry trends, and market positioning to communicate Vinci’s differentiators effectively.

Qualifications (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Education: Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related technical field.

  • Technical depth: Expert-level mastery of commercial FEA software (e.g., Ansys Mechanical, Abaqus, or equivalent), with 15+ years of hands-on experience in thermo-mechanical simulations— either as a practitioner running simulations or as a technical account manager for commercial physics simulation software.

  • Industry Domain: Deep familiarity with semiconductor electronics packaging, advanced packaging technologies (e.g., 2.5D/3D IC), or foundry ecosystems.

  • Customer Engagement: Prior experience in dedicated customer-facing roles, with a strong ability to build trust and manage engineering client relationships.

  • Automation & Scripting: Practical programming experience using Python or C++ to automate workflows or parse simulation data.

  • Leadership Impact: Proven track record of prior managerial or technical leadership experience, with the ability to scale, mentor, and drive execution across engineering teams.

  • Communication: Elite interpersonal and communication skills, with a proven ability to distill complex physics and simulation results into clear, high-impact narratives for both deep technical panels and business-oriented executives.

Preferred (Desirable Differentiators)

  • Multiphysics Breadth: Familiarity with thermal management and cooling solutions and/or Electrical Signal Integrity and Power Integrity (SI/PI) workflows.

  • Commercial Track Record: Direct experience commercializing technical software—ideally electronic design automation (EDA) or CAE simulation tools—into major semiconductor and electronics enterprises.

  • Go-To-Market Experience: Prior experience explicitly within technical pre-sales, application engineering (FAE), or strategic technical sales environments.

  • Emerging Tech Adjacency: Ability to rapidly adopt and champion next-generation, physics-based workflows and AI-assisted design or simulation tools.

Why Join Us

  • Not just use AI; be part of a team actively redefining how next-generation silicon and hardware are architected.

  • Work at the absolute convergence of state-of-the-art AI models, fundamental physics, and high-stakes enterprise engineering.

Collaborate with world-class engineers and researchers in a fast-moving startup environment.

À propos de Vinci

Vinci développe une IA fondée sur la physique (Physics AI) pour la conception de systèmes hardware. Notre plateforme donne aux équipes de conception et de simulation des prédictions physiques précises, obtenues en une fraction du temps d'une simulation classique, et qui s'intègrent à leurs outils existants.

C'est la première solution à offrir à la fois la rigueur de la simulation traditionnelle et la vitesse de l'IA. Elle transforme la façon dont les semi-conducteurs les plus avancés au monde sont conçus, vérifiés, fabriqués, mis sur le marché et intégrés dans des systèmes complexes.

Présentation du poste

En tant que membre clé de notre équipe européenne de Forward Deployment, vous jouerez un rôle déterminant dans l'adoption de la plateforme Vinci par les principales organisations d'ingénierie de la région. Dans ce rôle stratégique, vous constituerez, accompagnerez et dirigerez une équipe performante de spécialistes en ingénierie thermique, chargée d'accompagner nos clients et prospects et de démontrer concrètement la valeur de notre logiciel.

En tant que référent technique de confiance auprès de nos clients, vous et votre équipe mettrez à profit votre expertise approfondie en simulation pour aider nos clients industriels à valider et optimiser des conceptions complexes dans des conditions représentatives de leurs applications réelles. À travers ces collaborations, vous démontrerez comment la plateforme Vinci permet d'améliorer les performances thermiques et la fiabilité des produits, tout en accélérant les cycles de conception et la mise sur le marché.

Grâce à votre solide maîtrise de la mécanique des milieux continus, vous guiderez l'analyse de phénomènes physiques complexes : comportements linéaires, non-linéarités géométriques et matérielles, et interactions de contact. Votre équipe aidera les clients à évaluer des paramètres critiques tels que le warpage, l'évolution des contraintes, le cyclage thermique et la fiabilité, sur des composants semi-conducteurs avancés, des packages électroniques et des systèmes à l'échelle du wafer.

Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes d'ingénierie de nos clients afin de comprendre leurs problématiques techniques, de leur apporter une expertise approfondie et de démontrer clairement comment Vinci peut répondre à leurs cas d'usage concrets. Vous jouerez également un rôle essentiel d'interface entre les clients et nos équipes Product et Engineering, en transformant les retours du terrain en informations exploitables pour orienter la feuille de route produit et contribuer à l'amélioration continue de la plateforme.

Ce poste est basé en France et exercé en télétravail, avec une collaboration étroite avec les équipes Sales, Product et Engineering basées à Palo Alto, en Californie. Il implique des déplacements réguliers mais modérés, principalement en Europe continentale, ainsi que des déplacements occasionnels aux États-Unis pour collaborer avec l'équipe américaine.

Responsabilités

  • Construire, diriger et développer une équipe performante d'ingénieur/es en thermomécanique, en définissant l'orientation technique, en recrutant et accompagnant les membres de l'équipe, et en pilotant l'exécution sur le terrain à travers l'Europe.

  • Collaborer étroitement avec l'équipe Sales pour diriger les discussions techniques, définir le périmètre des évaluations en proof-of-concept (PoC) et réaliser des démonstrations de produits convaincantes auprès de clients industriels potentiels.

  • Accompagner les équipes d'ingénierie des clients pendant la phase d'évaluation en supervisant la mise en place des simulations, l'exécution de cas de test complexes et l'interprétation des résultats afin de démontrer concrètement la valeur technique et business de Vinci.

We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel. Read more about what we’re building here.

We’re looking for a commercially sharp, highly autonomous operator to drive Axle’s commercial success in the French market.

Axle has quickly become the leader in our operational markets, and we’re now looking to expand our reach internationally. Our goal is to become the go-to platform for energy flexibility globally, and we’re hiring the person to make that happen.

This role will assess Axle’s participation in French markets and business models from first principles: diving deep into regulations, modelling revenue-per-asset, and trialling new propositions at pace.

You speak French and fluent English. Other European languages will also be an asset.

What you will be doing

  • Owning Axle’s commercial results in the French market: pipeline, revenue and partner success

The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world.

Arago is backed by executives from Apple, Arm, Nvidia, Microsoft, and Hugging Face, as well as prominent US and European deeptech venture firms and exited founders.

What you’ll do

Design, integrate, and deliver high-performance digital subsystems within mixed-signal ICs, enabling control, calibration, and high-speed data movement in analog-centric environments — owning the flow from RTL to physical implementation and tape-out.

Responsibilities

  • Design and verify digital subsystems that interface directly with high-speed analog and mixed-signal circuits — including calibration engines, control FSMs, data converters, and multiplexing logic.

  • Contribute to the design of analog components at the digital-analog interface: calibration circuits, DACs/ADCs, comparators, and others.

  • Integrate and customize external IP blocks (e.g., GPIOs, LVDS I/Os, serial interfaces), ensuring compliance with analog signal and timing requirements.

  • Lead the digital implementation flow for mixed-signal blocks: from RTL to synthesis, floorplanning, P&R, timing closure, physical signoff, and tape-out.

  • Collaborate closely with analog, layout, and system teams to co-optimize digital-analog boundaries, resolve cross-domain issues, and ensure robust high-speed performance.

  • Contribute to the development of high-speed serial I/O subsystems — experience in the design and implementation of SerDes blocks is a significant advantage.

  • Language: English at a proficient level. French is a plus.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Strong experience in digital RTL design (Verilog/SystemVerilog), particularly for mixed-signal systems involving high-speed calibration/control loops, converters, multiplexers, and serial/parallel data paths.

  • Experience with analog IC development environments (Virtuoso or equivalent).

  • Deep understanding of digital-analog integration challenges, including timing closure, noise coupling, clock domain crossing, and analog-aware floorplanning in high-speed environments.

  • Proven ability to drive digital blocks from design through verification, synthesis, floorplanning, P&R, and tape-out, especially in the context of analog or RF ICs.

  • Skilled in integrating and adapting external IPs such as GPIOs, LVDS, SPI/I²C interfaces; experience with high-speed serializers/deserializers (SerDes) is a highly valued plus.

  • Proficient with industry-standard EDA toolchains for both front-end (design/verification) and back-end (physical implementation), with a strong grasp of mixed-signal layout constraints.

Pay and benefits

Software Engineer Infrastructure

Software Engineer, Infrastructure

Hybrid in Palo Alto (Mon / Wed / Thurs) Â· $185Kâ$215K base + meaningful early-stage equity + full benefits

Â 

About Sodalis

Specialty pharmacy is where the most complex and expensive drugs reach the most in-need patients, and it still runs on faxes, phone tag, and manual data entry. Patients wait weeks for therapies that can't wait.

Sodalis is building AI agents that run those operations end to end: reading and validating prescriptions, handling phone calls, and moving prescriptions through eligibility and fulfillment. The ambition goes beyond that. We want to be the rails every specialty prescription runs on, and the first system to perform clinical review at the standard of a pharmacist.

We're already in production, processing tens of thousands of prescriptions a week. Backed by Gradient Ventures (Google's AI fund), and founded by veterans of Apple's Applied ML, Included Health, and Avella Specialty Pharmacy (scaled to $1.5B+ before its acquisition by OptumRx).

Â 

The Opportunity

Everything we run today is cloud-based, and so are the pharmacy management systems we integrate with. But most of the specialty pharmacy market runs on-prem. To reach it, our system has to run on the pharmacy's systems instead of ours. Whether that's the full stack on-site or a hybrid split with our cloud is one of the first decisions you'd make. That's the problem you'd own.
We've never shipped an on-prem deployment, so there's no pattern to follow. You'll decide how our architecture gets packaged and deployed into environments we don't control, what has to change in our current infrastructure to make that possible, and how we maintain and see into those deployments once they're live.

We don't yet know what these environments look like in detail. Some pharmacies may have restricted outbound access, legacy hardware, or IT teams that can't give us a login; others may be more open. Part of the job is going in with our customer, finding out what's actually there, and designing something that works across the range.
You'll start with our AI pharmacy tech product, rolling out with a committed customer, so you build against a real deployment instead of a hypothetical one. You'd work directly with the founders and the early engineering team on the architecture.

What you'll do

  • Decide how our architecture runs in a pharmacy's environment, starting with the AI pharmacy tech product: full stack on-site, a hybrid split with our cloud, or something in between.

  • Adapt our current infrastructure and build the packaging and deployment path that installs and updates Sodalis at each pharmacy.

  • Own those deployments over time: upgrades, rollbacks, and observability into health and failures without being on site.

  • Go in with our customer and pharmacy IT teams to learn what their environments actually allow, and design for the range.

  • Partner with the founders and early engineering team on architecture.

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years in infrastructure or platform engineering.

  • You've taken an AWS-native stack and made it run on Kubernetes or similar in environments you don't operate, including stateful services.

  • You've shipped and maintained software running in environments you don't control: on-prem, customer-hosted, edge, or embedded.

  • You've kept a fleet of remote installs updated, observable, and recoverable without being able to log into them.

  • You've set the first pattern for something in a startup and are comfortable with ambiguity.

  • You'll spend time with pharmacy IT teams and need to understand their constraints firsthand. No healthcare background required.

How we work

We're a handful of people going all in on a problem we think is worth it, holding a high bar and shipping work that reaches real patients. It's intense, and it isn't for everyone. We want people who want to build something that matters, alongside others who care as much as they do. If that's you, we should talk.

jobs.description:
Identity & Access Management Engineer

Who is Sonar?

Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development.

Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence. 

Position description

We are looking for an experienced Identity & Access Management (IAM) Engineer to design, build, and operate the identity platforms that secure access to our applications, infrastructure, and data. You will own the technical direction of our IAM ecosystem, including authentication, authorization, lifecycle management, and privileged access. You will work with security, IT, engineering, and compliance teams to deliver a secure, scalable, and user-friendly access experience aligned with Zero Trust principles.


What you will do

  • Design, implement, and maintain enterprise IAM solutions, including SSO, MFA, federation, and directory services.

  • Architect and manage identity lifecycle processes (joiner/mover/leaver), automating provisioning and deprovisioning across SaaS, cloud, and on-prem systems.

  • Implement and operate Privileged Access Management (PAM), including vaulting, session management, and just-in-time access.

  • Lead Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) initiatives such as access reviews, certifications, role-based access control (RBAC), and segregation-of-duties controls.

  • Integrate applications with the identity platform using SAML, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SCIM, and LDAP.

  • Develop automation and tooling (APIs, scripts, CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code) to reduce manual identity operations.

  • Secure cloud identity and access across AWS, Azure, and/or GCP, including IAM policies, workload identity, and service accounts.

  • Define and enforce authentication and authorization standards, policies, and best practices.

  • Monitor identity-related threats and support detection and response for account compromise, credential abuse, and privilege escalation.


Experience and qualifications

  • 6 to 15 years of experience in IAM, security engineering, or a related field.

  • Hands-on experience with at least one major IAM platform such as Okta, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Ping Identity, ForgeRock, SailPoint, or CyberArk.

  • Strong knowledge of identity protocols and standards: SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SCIM, LDAP, and Kerberos.

  • Experience with Active Directory and directory services architecture.

  • Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language (Python, PowerShell, Go, Java, or JavaScript).

  • Solid understanding of cloud IAM models (AWS IAM, Azure RBAC, GCP IAM).

  • Experience with MFA, passwordless, and conditional or risk-based access.

  • Familiarity with Zero Trust, least privilege, and defense-in-depth principles.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

Additional comments

This role is based in Geneva. We are unable to consider candidates unwilling to be in Geneva, but we are willing to relocate the right candidate.

We value diversity, equity, and inclusion

At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

If you need any accommodation, please reach out to us at All offers of employment at Sonar are contingent upon the results of a comprehensive background check and reference verification conducted before the start date. 

Applications that are submitted through agencies or third party recruiters will not be considered.

jobs.title: Staff Solutions Architect
jobs.description:
Staff Solutions Architect

From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.
Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.
During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About The Role

A Staff Solutions Architect is a senior pre-sales technical leader who partners with sales, customers, partners, and internal stakeholders to shape technical strategy, design strong dbt-centered solutions, and convert technical progress into predictable commercial outcomes. The role includes the full Senior Solutions Architect foundation and adds broader scope, deeper architectural leadership, stronger influence across complex accounts, and greater contribution to reusable patterns, enablement, and field standards.

This role is well suited to someone who enjoys creating opportunities as much as closing them. You’ll play a hands-on role in outbound prospecting, shaping your own pipeline and guiding customers through thoughtful, consultative sales conversations. This is a high-ownership role with significant autonomy and responsibility from day one.

What you'll do:

  • Lead technical discovery to understand business drivers, technical context, constraints, decision process, and success criteria.
  • Run product demonstrations, workshops, evaluations, and proof-oriented engagements that map dbt capabilities to real customer problems.
  • Design pragmatic solution architectures spanning dbt, warehouses, orchestration, BI, governance, and adjacent ecosystem tooling.
  • Partner closely with account teams on qualification, technical win criteria, risks, next steps, and forecast accuracy.
  • Act as a trusted technical advisor for analytics engineers, data engineers, architects, and technical decision-makers.
  • Communicate complex topics clearly in both written and verbal form, adapting depth and framing to the audience.
  • Support customer adoption and expansion by connecting technical outcomes to additional use cases and long-term platform value.
  • Model dbt values through professionalism, curiosity, accountability, collaboration, and a growth mindset.

What differentiates a Staff Solutions Architect:

In addition to the responsibilities above, a Staff Solutions Architect is expected to:

  • Consistently frame strong early technical angles that improve pipeline quality and qualification.
  • Uncover root causes, decision processes, and hidden constraints in varied and often complex customer situations.
  • Use the sales process deliberately to structure technical work, maintain clear status, and provide actionable risk assessments.
  • Engage as a credible peer on design, performance, maintainability, and architecture trade-offs across the modern data stack.
  • Deliver well-phased architectures that reflect organizational complexity, adoption realities, governance needs, and long-term evolution.
  • Design strong integration approaches across multiple warehouses, orchestrators, BI tools, and partner technologies.
  • Equip champions with compelling narratives, proof points, and technical materials that help advance initiatives internally.
  • Maintain a complete and comprehensible view of deals, workload, and technical milestones that improves forecasting quality.
  • Generate reusable demos, templates, write-ups, patterns, and assets that other SAs can adopt and adapt.
  • Build strong cross-functional partnerships across sales, product, marketing, success, partners, and the broader SA organization.
  • Influence how dbt-centric architecture patterns are defined, scaled, and reused beyond a single account or territory.

Skills we're looking for:

A strong candidate for this role will typically bring:

  • Experience in pre-sales, solutions architecture, sales engineering, or a comparable customer-facing technical role.
  • Strong understanding of dbt, analytics engineering, SQL, data transformation, and modern cloud data platforms.
  • Ability to lead technical strategy in complex enterprise opportunities with multiple stakeholders and moving parts.
  • Comfort navigating ambiguity, balancing short-term deal support with long-term architectural quality, and operating in a fast-changing environment.
  • Evidence of mentoring, force-multiplying peers, or creating assets and practices that improve team effectiveness.
  • Strong executive communication, technical storytelling, and written documentation skills.

jobs.title: Senior Analyst, Treasury & Tax Operations
jobs.description:
Senior Analyst, Treasury & Tax Operations

A Little About Us

EDB provides a data and AI platform that enables organizations to harness the full power of Postgres for transactional, analytical, and AI workloads across any cloud, anywhere. EDB empowers enterprises to control risk, manage costs and scale efficiently for a data and AI led world. Serving more than 1,500 customers globally and as the leading contributor to the vibrant and fast-growing PostgreSQL community, EDB supports major government organizations, financial services, media and information technology companies. EDB’s data-driven solutions enable customers to modernize legacy systems and break data silos while leveraging enterprise-grade open source technologies. EDB delivers the confidence of up to 99.999% high availability with mission critical capabilities built in such as security, compliance controls, and observability. For more information, visit www.enterprisedb.com

Job Summary

We are seeking a Senior Analyst, Treasury & Tax Operations to join our team at EDB, reporting directly to the Senior Director, Global Controller. In this hands-on role, you will run the day-to-day treasury and tax operations of EDB’s global business across multiple entities, banks and currencies, owning payment approval oversight and bank portal access and signatory governance, coordinating US indirect tax compliance with our external providers, and supporting cash management and investments, corporate income tax and transfer pricing. You will partner closely across our Controllership team, as well as FP&A, Legal and our external tax advisors.

This is a unique opportunity to work directly with EDB’s senior Finance leadership, with high visibility and a genuine position of influence over critical functions.

The ideal candidate is a controls-minded treasury and tax professional who has personally run payment, banking and indirect tax operations for a multi-entity, multi-currency business, takes ownership without needing direction, and keeps a lean function accurate, secure and audit-ready.

What your impact will be:

Payment Controls & Treasury Operations

  • Oversee the approval workflow for payments across global bank accounts, ensuring payments are in compliance with approval limits, segregation of duties and company policy.
  • Own the payment request process, escalate unusual or out-of-policy requests, and work with banks and internal stakeholders to resolve rejected, delayed or failed payments.
  • Maintain the payment approval matrices and authority limits.
  • Schedule and execute debt service payments, including interest, repayments and agency fees.
  • Support the bank reconciliations process, resolve treasury-related queries, and support internal and external audit requests related to treasury controls.

Bank Administration & Access Controls

  • Process user access updates for bank portals and treasury systems based on leadership approvals, applying role-based permissions on the principle of least privilege.
  • Remove access promptly for leavers and role changes, and perform periodic user access reviews across all banking platforms.
  • Partner with Legal to add or remove authorized signatories, preparing and tracking board resolutions, incumbency certificates and bank mandates.
  • Own day-to-day bank KYC and AML requirements, including account openings, periodic refreshes and lender requests, partnering with Legal on entity documentation.
  • Maintain an up-to-date signatory register across all entities, accounts and banks.

Cash Management & Investments

  • Partner with FP&A on the consolidated 13-week cash flow forecast, reviewing bank data feeds for accuracy and providing insight on cash positioning, timing and opportunities to optimize liquidity.
  • Coordinate intercompany funding across EDB’s global entities, assessing entity-level cash needs, executing funding movements and maintaining the funding log, working with regional accounting teams.
  • Execute approved short-term cash investments, including money market and deposit activity, monitoring yields, liquidity and counterparty exposure.
  • Prepare regular treasury reporting for senior leadership, covering cash position, liquidity, investments and bank counterparty exposure.
  • Champion automation and AI to continuously improve treasury and tax processes, documentation and controls.

Tax Operations

  • Prepare data and coordinate filings for US sales and use tax, including returns, nexus monitoring and new state registrations, and support indirect tax compliance globally.
  • Prepare corporate income tax estimates, and execute and track tax payments, including withholding tax on cross-border payments.
  • Coordinate R&D tax credit claims with our external advisors, gathering qualifying payroll, contractor and project data from Engineering and People.
  • Serve as the primary operational contact for our external tax providers, managing data requests and deadlines, and helping us use them more efficiently.
  • Support intercompany settlements in line with our transfer pricing policy.
  • Take a leading role on indirect tax matters for acquisitions and integrations, and support ad hoc tax and transfer pricing projects.

What you will bring:

  • 5+ years of experience in treasury, tax or a closely related finance role in a multi-entity, multi-currency environment.
  • Strong understanding of payment controls, segregation of duties and user access governance.
  • Experience preparing bank documentation (KYC, mandates, incumbency certificates, signatory changes) across multiple banking partners and jurisdictions.
  • Familiarity with cross-border payments, withholding tax, intercompany settlements and short-term cash investments.
  • Advanced Excel skills; experience with Avalara & NetSuite strongly preferred
  • Experience in a high-growth or private-equity-backed technology company strongly preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting or a related discipline

What will give you an edge:

  • Hands-on experience overseeing payment approval workflows and administering multi-bank portals; CitiDirect or comparable platforms a plus.
  • Hands-on experience with US sales and use tax compliance, including multi-state registrations and filings; exposure to global indirect tax (VAT/GST) a plus.
  • Experience with Pigment or a comparable planning tool a plus.
  • Professional qualification in treasury (AMCT or CTP), tax (CTA, or IPT’s CMI in sales and use tax) or accounting (CPA, ACA, ACCA or CIMA), completed or in progress, a plus.

EDB is committed to supporting our employees' overall well being by offering a range of benefits and resources to promote a healthy work-life balance and wellness. We provide access to CuraLinc to aid employees in health and wellness tips and practices, as well as Wellness Fridays extending to December 2026! Check out our career site for more information on perks and benefits and reach out to our Talent Acquisition team for region specific benefits.

We know it takes a unique mix of people and skills to help us in our mission to supercharge Postgres, and we understand that not everyone will check every box. We’d love to hear from you and we want you to apply!

EDB is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. EDB was built on a commitment to trust and respect each other and to embrace an array of people and ideas. These values remain at the center of our culture and are key to our company’s integrity.

jobs.description:
Product Manager, Salesforce

About Kaseya

Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success.

Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide.

Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe.

We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in.

At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it.

Position Summary

Kaseya is seeking a strategic, detail-oriented Product Manager to join our Business Information Systems (BIS) team. This individual will drive the vision, roadmap, and execution of enterprise capabilities supporting our Product Business Systems (PBS), with a focus on product configuration, pricing, fulfillment, software provisioning, entitlements, usage, and overage management.

This role will support Kaseya’s current operating environment while helping shape the future-state architecture and processes needed to support continued growth and transformation. PBS capabilities span multiple platforms, including Salesforce, NetSuite, integrations, and Kaseya products such as Kaseya One. As Kaseya evolves its enterprise systems landscape, this individual will help guide the transition toward a scalable architecture anchored by Salesforce Revenue Cloud Advanced (RCA), Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Oracle ERP, and related applications.

The ideal candidate brings a strong understanding of the Lead-to-Cash lifecycle within an enterprise SaaS environment, including product and pricing configuration, bundle management, software license provisioning, entitlement management, and usage-based billing. This person must be comfortable navigating complex integrations, balancing competing priorities, and partnering across business and technical teams to simplify legacy processes, strengthen controls, and deliver scalable solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Product Strategy and Roadmap: Define and manage the product roadmap for Product and Pricing, Fulfillment, and Provisioning capabilities, ensuring alignment with corporate strategy, revenue operations priorities, finance transformation goals, customer experience improvements, and future-state migration objectives.
  • Product and Pricing Management: Lead capabilities related to product configuration, catalog management, SKU creation, product hierarchies, master data governance, pricing models, discount management, renewal pricing, promotions, and bundle configuration.
  • Fulfillment and Provisioning: Drive requirements and solutions for automated, manual, and hybrid provisioning models, fulfillment routing, tenant and instance creation, customer-to-tenant mapping, license provisioning, and entitlement lifecycle management.
  • Lead-to-Cash Lifecycle: Lead requirements definition and solution alignment across the Lead-to-Cash lifecycle, including product and pricing setup, order fulfillment, provisioning, usage capture, overage management, billing, revenue recognition, and reporting.
  • Product Ownership and Agile Delivery: Own and manage the product backlog, develop clear user stories and acceptance criteria, and lead backlog refinement, sprint planning, discovery sessions, solution reviews, demonstrations, and other Agile ceremonies.
  • Systems and Integration Management: Serve as a subject matter expert across current and future-state platforms, including Salesforce, Salesforce Revenue Cloud Advanced, NetSuite, Oracle ERP, MuleSoft, Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), Kaseya One, and related applications. Partner with technical teams to ensure reliable integrations and consistent data flows.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Finance, Billing Operations, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Customer Operations, Product, Engineering, Enterprise Architecture, Security, and IT to gather requirements, prioritize initiatives, resolve issues, and deliver scalable business outcomes.
  • Business Process Optimization: Identify opportunities to simplify workflows, reduce manual intervention, clarify ownership, improve operational handoffs, strengthen governance, and increase automation across PBS capabilities.
  • Transformation and Migration Readiness: Balance support for legacy systems with future-state transformation priorities, ensuring legacy enhancements deliver measurable value, reduce operational risk, or improve migration readiness.
  • Governance, Risk, and Compliance: Ensure solutions align with enterprise policies, internal controls, data privacy, and security requirements. Maintain clear documentation of requirements, business rules, integration dependencies, decisions, testing coverage, and operational readiness.
  • Continuous Improvement: Monitor system performance, user adoption, data quality, defect trends, billing accuracy, provisioning effectiveness, and operational outcomes to identify opportunities for improvement and scalability.
  • Delivery and Stakeholder Alignment: Partner with Engineering Leads, QA, Scrum Masters, Business Process Leads, and Release/PMO teams to manage dependencies, remove blockers, coordinate testing, and deliver capabilities aligned with business objectives and release milestones.

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in product management, product ownership, business systems analysis, CRM systems, revenue operations systems, or enterprise solution delivery.
  • Proven experience with Lead-to-Cash, Quote-to-Cash, or subscription lifecycle processes within an enterprise SaaS environment.
  • Strong working knowledge of Salesforce CPQ, Salesforce Revenue Cloud, Revenue Cloud Advanced, or comparable enterprise product configuration and pricing platforms.
  • Experience with product catalog management, SKU management, pricing configuration, discounting, bundle management, or product master data governance.
  • Hands-on experience with software license provisioning, entitlement management, or fulfillment workflows, including integrations using platforms such as MuleSoft or Boomi.
  • Experience with usage-based pricing models, including usage capture, rating, overage management, and associated billing or revenue processes.
  • Understanding of integrated system flows across sales, order management, billing, accounts receivable, collections, revenue recognition, and reporting.
  • Demonstrated success managing cross-functional Agile delivery teams and driving complex enterprise initiatives from requirements through implementation.
  • Strong understanding of business process mapping, technical integrations, data dependencies, user stories, acceptance criteria, and system controls.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to influence decisions and drive alignment across business and technical teams.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, evolving environment while balancing business-as-usual support, competing priorities, and future-state transformation initiatives.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Salesforce Revenue Cloud Advanced (RCA), Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Oracle ERP, NetSuite, MuleSoft, or Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC).
  • Experience supporting enterprise SaaS subscription models, managed service providers (MSPs), usage-based billing, and customer lifecycle processes.
  • Familiarity with Kaseya One or comparable software provisioning, entitlement, and license management platforms.
  • Experience with revenue operations, billing operations, finance transformation, or enterprise business systems within a complex, integrated technology environment.
  • Experience supporting enterprise architecture modernization, legacy platform transitions, data governance initiatives, and large-scale systems migration.
  • Knowledge of revenue recognition and billing metadata requirements associated with product, pricing, usage, and subscription management.

Additional information
Kaseya provides equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, age, ancestry, gender, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

jobs.title: Website Growth Marketing Manager (m/w/d) - Germany
jobs.description:
Website Growth Marketing Manager (m/w/d) - Germany
 

Möchtest du das tägliche Leben von Millionen von Unternehmern in Deutschland (und bald in Europa) beeinflussen? Suchst du nach einem Arbeitsumfeld, das Vertrauen, Proaktivität und Autonomie schätzt? Stimmen unsere Company Values mit deiner Vision überein? Dann ist Pennylane der richtige Ort für dich!

 

Unsere Vision

Wir wollen das beliebteste finanzielle Betriebssystem für KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und Steuerberatungsgesellschaften werden.

Wir helfen Unternehmern, sich von zeitraubenden Aufgaben rund um Buchhaltung und Finanzen zu befreien, während wir ihnen gleichzeitig Zugang zu wichtigen Finanzinformationen verschaffen, um die besten Entscheidungen für ihr Unternehmen zu treffen.

 

Über uns

Pennylane ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintechs in Frankreich (und jetzt auch in Deutschland!).

In 5 Jahren unseres Bestehens haben wir Folgendes erreicht:

💻 Wir haben uns als bahnbrechende Buchhaltungs- und Finanzsoftware für kleine Unternehmen und ihre Buchhalter bekannt gemacht.

💰 Wir haben insgesamt 225 Millionen Euro eingesammelt, unter anderem von Sequoia, dem berühmten Fonds aus dem Silicon Valley, der früh in Unternehmen wie Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal und viele mehr investiert hat...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Wir sind von 7 Mitbegründern auf 900 zufriedene Pennylaner angewachsen: Wir gelten heute als einer der besten Arbeitsplätze in Frankreich (auch remote), mit einer Bewertung von 4,6/5 auf Glassdoor.

🌍 Wir haben ein internationales Umfeld mit mehr als 25 Nationalitäten aufgebaut, mit einer starken Remote-freundlichen Kultur, in der 30 % der Mitarbeiter bereits aus allen Teilen Europas arbeiten.

🤝 Wir haben das Vertrauen Tausender von Kunden und Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften gewonnen und hervorragende Bewertungen erhalten.

🚀 Bereits mehr als 1 300.000 KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und über 5000 Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften nutzen Pennylane in Frankreich!

Dein Team und Umfeld

Pennylane wächst international: Nach Frankreich bauen wir unsere Websites und Conversion-Funnels für Spanien, Deutschland und die USA aus. Deutschland ist dabei ein strategischer Fokusmarkt. Dafür suchen wir dich: Du entwickelst die deutsche Website als eigenständiges Produkt weiter – mit einem klaren Blick auf den Markt, unsere Zielgruppen und ihre Bedürfnisse.

Du wirst Teil unseres Website-Teams im Bereich Growth und berichtest direkt an den Head of Growth. Gemeinsam mit Growth Engineers und Designern arbeitest du in einer festen Squad. Dabei bist du täglich mittendrin, packst selbst mit an und bringst Verbesserungen gemeinsam mit deinem Team live.

Deine Mission

Du verantwortest und optimierst die Conversion-Rate unserer Websites für den deutschen Markt: pennylane.com/de und start.pennylane.com. Für jede Zielgruppe schaffst du ein passendes Nutzererlebnis: Selbstständige, kleine und mittlere Unternehmen, größere Mittelständler und Steuerkanzleien.

Von der ersten Analyse bis zur umgesetzten Verbesserung liegt der gesamte Prozess bei dir. Du erkennst Hürden, entwickelst die Strategie, testest neue Ansätze und machst ihren Erfolg messbar.

Deine Aufgaben

1. Conversion optimieren und kontinuierlich experimentieren

  • Du entwickelst die Conversion-Strategie für den deutschen Funnel – von der Startseite über Preis- und Produktseiten bis zur Demo-Buchung und eigenständigen Registrierung.

  • Du treibst einen kontinuierlichen A/B-Testprozess voran: Ideen entwickeln, Tests planen, live bringen, auswerten und weiterentwickeln. Laufende Experimente gehören für dich zum Alltag.

  • Mit Analytics, Heatmaps und Verhaltensanalysen identifizierst du Hürden und Potenziale entlang der Nutzerreise, unter anderem mit Amplitude und Tracking-Daten.

  • Du führst ein umfassendes CRO-Audit der deutschen Website durch und vergleichst Funnel, Preisseite und Startseite mit führenden B2B-Websites.

2. Die deutsche Website als Produkt weiterentwickeln

  • Du verantwortest die Roadmap der deutschen Website und priorisierst nach Wirkung und Umsetzbarkeit.

  • Du entwickelst das Portal für Steuerkanzleien, die Marketplace-Integration und den Demo-Buchungsprozess für den deutschen Markt weiter.

  • Du verantwortest unser CMS Contentful: von einer klaren Struktur über wiederverwendbare Komponenten bis zum Aufbau neuer Seiten.

  • Gemeinsam mit Growth Engineering verantwortest du den gesamten Self-Service-Registrierungsprozess für Deutschland: das deutsche Formular, die automatische Ergänzung von Unternehmensdaten und eindeutige Unternehmenszuordnung über Northdata, die Datenübertragung an Salesforce und die Kontoerstellung über die Produkt-API.

3. Die Umsetzung im Team vorantreiben

  • Du koordinierst die Zusammenarbeit von UX, Engineering und Data – mit einem priorisierten Backlog, klaren Spezifikationen, konsequenter Nachverfolgung und Qualitätssicherung.

  • Du moderierst Weeklys, Dailys und Retros und sorgst dafür, dass Tickets zügig von der Planung bis zur Veröffentlichung vorankommen.

  • Du koordinierst Content, Product Marketing und Lokalisierung: von der KI-gestützten Übersetzung über die Prüfung durch Muttersprachler bis zur Integration ins CMS.

  • Du nutzt KI, um Prozesse und Reporting zu automatisieren.

4. Teams und Stakeholder zusammenbringen

  • Du arbeitest eng mit SEO, SEA, Content, Product Marketing, Product, Legal und dem deutschen Marktteam zusammen – unter anderem an Landingpages zu RFE, Compte Pro und E-Rechnung.

  • Du bringst unterschiedliche Stakeholder auf einen gemeinsamen Kurs und gewinnst ihre Unterstützung, auch ohne disziplinarische Führungsverantwortung.

  • Du kommunizierst Prioritäten, Zeitpläne und wichtige Neuerungen klar und teamübergreifend.

Das bringst du mit

  • Erfahrung mit messbarer Wirkung: Du hast 3–4 Jahre Erfahrung im Product Management oder in der Conversion-Rate-Optimierung, idealerweise im B2B-SaaS- oder B2C-Umfeld. Du hast Features von der Idee bis zum Launch verantwortet und kannst anhand konkreter Kennzahlen zeigen, was sich dadurch verbessert hat.

  • Eigenständiger Umgang mit Daten und CRO-Tools: Du arbeitest sicher mit Tools wie Amplitude, GA4, Contentsquare oder Hotjar. Du ziehst deine Daten selbst, erkennst Muster und leitest Hypothesen ab, ohne auf eine Analyse durch andere angewiesen zu sein.

  • Fundierte A/B-Testing-Kenntnisse: Du weißt, wie du die nötige Stichprobengröße bestimmst, eine klare Erfolgskennzahl definierst und typische Fehler vermeidest – etwa Tests aufgrund vorläufiger Ergebnisse zu früh zu beenden oder mit zu kleinen Stichproben zu arbeiten.

  • Klare Kommunikation: Du schreibst präzise Briefings für Designer, erklärst Priorisierungsentscheidungen auch gegenüber skeptischen Stakeholdern und präsentierst Ergebnisse verständlich für ein nichttechnisches Publikum.

  • Sprachkenntnisse und Marktverständnis: Du sprichst fließend Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem oder vergleichbarem Niveau und kennst den deutschen Markt. Für die internationale Zusammenarbeit bringst du verhandlungssicheres Englisch mit. Französisch ist ein Plus.

Was wir tun, um dein Arbeitsleben besser zu machen

🏢 Du kannst remote aus deinem Wohnsitz arbeiten, solange es in Deutschland liegt. Regelmäßige Arbeit aus dem europäischen Ausland ist möglich, wenn die Zeitverschiebung zur MEZ (Mitteleuropäische Zeit) maximal zwei Stunden beträgt.

🌴 Unabhängig davon, wo du ansässig bist, erhältst du 30 von Pennylane bezahlte Urlaubstage. 💵 Du erhältst ein wettbewerbsfähiges Vergütungspaket.

📈 Du erhältst Unternehmensanteile, um vom Erfolg mitzuprofitieren, den du gemeinsam mit uns aufbaust.

🏡 Du erhältst ein Budget, um dein Zuhause in einen komfortableren Arbeitsplatz zu verwandeln, sowie eine monatliche Pauschale, um in einem Coworking Space zu arbeiten, wann immer du möchtest. In Berlin haben wir ein Office, aus dem regelmäßig gearbeitet werden kann.

💻 Du erhältst die neueste Apple-Ausrüstung.

🎉 Wir legen Wert auf regelmäßige gemeinsame Veranstaltungen wie unsere Tech Days (die Remote-Pennylaner alle 3 Monate zusammenbringen) oder unser jährliches Firmenseminar, um wichtige Momente des Zusammenhalts für alle zu schaffen.

 

Wen wir suchen

Um bei Pennylane erfolgreich zu sein, benötigst du:

- Englischkenntnisse (das Niveau wird je nach Abteilung, für die du dich bewirbst, bewertet und eingeschätzt).

- Begeisterung für ein sich ständig wandelndes Arbeitsumfeld.

- Hohe Kooperationsbereitschaft (innerhalb deines Teams oder mit anderen Stakeholdern).

- Ausreichend Erfahrung, um deine täglichen Aufgaben nach geschäftlichen Prioritäten auszurichten.

 

Wir wissen, dass einige Menschen eher zögern, sich zu bewerben, wenn sie das Gefühl haben, nicht die gesamte Liste der Kriterien zu erfüllen. Wenn du unsicher bist, ermutigen wir dich, dich trotzdem zu bewerben: Wer weiß, vielleicht ist es der Beginn einer sinnvollen und langfristigen Zusammenarbeit.

 

Wir möchten auch betonen, dass wir Vielfalt, Gleichheit und Inklusion voll und ganz befürworten und unser Bestes tun, um ein sicheres und integratives Umfeld zu schaffen. Wir verpflichten uns, gleiche Beschäftigungsmöglichkeiten unabhängig von Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Herkunft, Behinderungen oder anderen Merkmalen, die dich ausmachen, zu gewährleisten. Im Gegenteil, Vielfalt macht uns zu einem noch besseren Arbeitsplatz.

🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten

Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an Mehr erfahren

Visit our Institutional Page

You will join an engineering squad in our Berlin office working on distributed systems and platform infrastructure. Our products serve analytics engineers and business teams across the company, but this is primarily a systems engineering role (roughly 75% core software systems engineering, 25% data architecture). We value engineering depth: we build internal distributed solutions and understand the runtimes underneath, rather than only orchestrating managed tools.

As a Senior Software Engineer you will shape the architecture of our low-level infrastructure, orchestration frameworks and storage engines. You will lead technical design, resolve systemic bottlenecks in compute and streaming layers, and mentor engineers across squads, working with colleagues in Berlin, the US and Latin America.

What you will do

  • Work with Analytics Engineering leads and platform users to define internal APIs, developer toolchains and data modeling practices that speed up developers company-wide.

  • Set standards for resilience testing, automated failover, observability and architectural documentation.

What you bring

  • Substantial experience designing, scaling and operating mission-critical distributed systems and backend architectures in high-throughput production environments.

  • Strong practical knowledge of container orchestration and systems management at scale, ideally Kubernetes internals and custom controllers or operators.

  • Advanced proficiency in a systems-oriented language such as Go, Java, Scala, Rust or C++.

  • Experience with database system architecture (storage engines, indexing, replication) and/or event-driven architectures using Apache Kafka.

  • A track record of technical leadership: writing design proposals, aligning teams on complex technical decisions, and mentoring engineers.

Nice to have

jobs.description:
Product Owner / Business Analyst / AMOA (H/F)

E-Finances développe et commercialise des logiciels de gestion financière utilisées par des entreprises en France et à l'international depuis 25 ans. Nos outils couvrent la gestion de trésorerie, les rapprochements bancaires et comptables, ainsi que la validation et la transmission sécurisée des paiements vers les banques (EBICS, SWIFT).  

Nous cherchons un(e) Product Owner, Business Analyst ou AMOA pour prendre en charge le backlog fonctionnel de nos produits. Vous travaillerez avec une équipe R&D de quatre développeurs et vous êtes rattaché(e) au responsable R&D. 

Ce que vous ferez 

  • Organiser le backlog produit, proposer les priorités et le tenir à jour. 
  • Qualifier les demandes et les anomalies remontées par le support et les clients, et proposer la suite à donner. 
  • Rédiger des tickets clairs et complets (user stories, critères d'acceptation), prêts à être développés. 
  • Écrire et tenir à jour les spécifications fonctionnelles et les règles métier. 
  • Suivre l'évolution des normes bancaires et leur impact sur nos produits. 
  • Animer les rituels agiles : daily, refinement, sprint planning, revue de sprint et rétrospective. 
  • Préparer et réaliser les recettes fonctionnelles (tests manuels), puis coordonner les mises en production avec la R&D. 
  • Documenter le paramétrage, en lien avec le support, et contribuer aux notes de version. 
  • Contribuer à la feuille de route fonctionnelle des produits, avec le responsable R&D. 

Vous êtes seul(e) sur ce rôle, mais pas isolé(e) : vous démarrez sur le produit principal, avec l'appui du responsable R&D et de collègues qui connaissent très bien les produits et les clients, puis vous élargissez progressivement votre périmètre.  

Votre profil 

Idéalement vous disposez d’expérience en gestion financière, incluant par exemple la gestion de trésorerie ou la comptabilité.  

Vous avez aussi : 

  • un bon esprit d'analyse et de synthèse, à l'écrit comme à l'oral 
  • l'envie de questionner les demandes et de proposer des solutions utiles aux clients 
  • de la rigueur : vous vérifiez avant d'affirmer 
  • de la curiosité pour le fonctionnement d'un logiciel : droits, données, paramétrage 
  • une expérience en recette ou en test 
  • la pratique de Jira et Confluence 
  • l'habitude d'utiliser des outils d'IA au quotidien 
  • l'anglais écrit, nos produits et leur documentation existent aussi en anglais 

Pourquoi nous rejoindre 

  • Des produits concrets, utilisés chaque jour par nos clients, dans un domaine exigeant (réglementation, sécurité). 
  • Un rôle où vous avez la main sur l'organisation du backlog et de la documentation produit. 
  • Une autonomie croissante dans les décisions fonctionnelles et la priorisation, à mesure que vous maîtrisez les produits. 
  • Une équipe à taille humaine, avec des échanges directs avec la direction, la R&D, le consulting et le support. 

Le processus de recrutement 

Quatre étapes : 

  1. Un premier échange d'environ 30 minutes avec le responsable R&D & IT et le responsable consulting. 
  1. Une étude de cas sur place, d'environ 1h30. 
  1. Une rencontre avec l'équipe. 
  1. Un dernier échange avec la direction.  

Infos pratiques 

  • Contrat : CDI, statut cadre. 
  • Lieu : Carquefou, en périphérie de Nantes. Une proximité géographique (moins d'une heure de trajet) est nécessaire pour venir régulièrement sur site.
