jobs.title: Founding Full-stack Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Founding Full-stack Software Engineer

Who we are

Lemrock builds the infrastructure of agentic commerce.

Tomorrow, consumers won't just buy on e-commerce websites. They will discover, compare and purchase directly inside conversational AI interfaces like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and a growing long tail of specialized AI assistants.

For brands, this is a major shift: if they are not present in these environments, they become invisible.

Our mission: enable any brand to exist, sell and distribute in this new channel.

We raised a €7M seed round (the first in Europe on this market), with Jean-Baptiste Rudelle, founder of Criteo, on our board, and the Bpifrance DeepTech label.

Today, Lemrock is already:

  • 100M+ conversations per month

  • 150+ brand clients

  • a $100B market structuring at high speed

Context

You'll join a small, high-ownership engineering team building production systems that serve millions of users. We care deeply about code quality and clean architecture — and we intend to keep it that way as we scale.

Your Mission

Your goal is to build and ship the product that powers Lemrock's commerce infrastructure — with full ownership, from design to production. Concretely, you will:

  • Ship features end-to-end that reach millions of users — from data model and API design to the interface they interact with.

  • Scale and harden our backend as traffic, integrations, and product complexity grow.

  • Shape the architecture of the codebase — enforce clean boundaries, maintain modularity, and make decisions that compound as the team scales.

  • Move fast across the stack — backend, frontend, infra, data — wherever the highest-impact work is on any given week.

Candidate Profile

  • Strong academic background, proven professional track record, or hands-on entrepreneurial experience

  • 4+ years of hands-on software engineering experience

  • Deep proficiency in TypeScript

  • Experience with structured backend architectures (DDD, hexagonal, or similar)

  • Has owned features end-to-end: data model → API → frontend → deployment

  • Comfortable with AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code)

  • Thrives in ambiguity and 0-to-1 environments — ex-founders or entrepreneurial mindsets are a strong fit

  • Professional proficiency in French & English

Tech Stack

Core (required)

  • TypeScript, NestJS, React

  • PostgreSQL, Redis

  • Docker

  • Clean architecture patterns (hexagonal, ports & adapters)

Bonus (appreciated but not required)

  • GCP (Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, BigQuery), Terraform

  • Vector databases, embeddings, LLM integrations

  • Domain-Driven Design (DDD), CQRS

  • TanStack (Router, Query, Table), shadcn/ui, Tailwind, Vite

  • Durable workflows (Inngest, Temporal)

Why Join Us

  • Join a company in early breakout mode, already generating revenue, with a clear technological edge and strong financial backing to fuel its growth

  • Work directly with an experienced team: two repeat YC founders who've scaled product & tech before, a former strategy/innovation director (10 years in the sector), and ex-strategy consultants (McKinsey QuantumBlack, BCG)

  • Be part of the next structural shift of the web — agentic interfaces

  • Own mission-critical topics, grow fast, and shape the company's future trajectory

Package

Competitive salary + equity, disclosed during the interview process.

Wir kennen die digitalen Herausforderungen unserer Kundschaft und liefern die passenden Lösungen. Dank unseres tiefen Fachwissens und unserem ausgeprägten technischem Weitblick gelingt es uns, die IT-Landschaften unserer Kunden kontinuierlich an die komplexen und sich ständig verändernden Anforderungen anzupassen.

Das gelingt dir durch...

  • sehr gute Kenntnis von mindestens drei relevanten SAP Produkten (Logistik, HCM, ERP, S/4 oder vergleichbares)

  • eine strukturierte und zielführende Arbeitsweise, Eigenverantwortung und Begeisterung für herausfordernde Tätigkeiten

  • Bereitschaft für Vor-Ort Termine bei Kunden

  • sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Benefits

Kostenloser Kaffee und Firmenparkplätze - kennst du vermutlich schon, oder?

Wir möchten dir da schon etwas mehr bieten:

Flexibles Jahresarbeitszeitmodell: Bye, 9-to-5! Deine Arbeitszeit kannst du dir bei uns frei einteilen.

Weiterbildung: Bleibe immer up to date – mit bis zu zwei Wochen bezahlter Weiterbildung kein Problem

Zukunftsorientierung: Als globale Tech-Company leben wir am Puls der Zeit und blicken stets in die Zukunft.

Tools: Digitale Werkzeuge – die Essentials deiner Karriere. Bei uns kannst du Laptop und Smartphone aber auch privat nutzen.

Teamspirit: Teambuildings oder Grillabende – wir finden immer einen Grund zusammenzukommen.

Come as you are!: Bei uns geht es um das, was du draufhast – nicht um das, was du anhast. Lieber Casual, Business oder etwas dazwischen - come as you are!

Mehr Ferientage: Die gesetzlich vorgeschriebenen Ferientage sind dir nicht genug? Uns auch nicht, denn mit leeren Batterien arbeitet es sich nicht sehr gut!

Workation & Entsendungen: Eigentlich am Schreibtisch aber mental schon wieder an deinem Lieblingsurlaubsort? Durch Workations und Entsendungen hat das Träumen ein Ende.

Work-Life-Balance: Schon viel davon gehört aber nie erlebt? Bei uns bestimmst du deine Balance.

Wellbeing: Es ist völlig okay, wenn nicht immer alles okay ist. Ob Stress, schlechter Schlaf oder schwierige Entscheidungen – unsere externe Online-Plattform bietet dir kostenlose, vertrauliche und anonyme Unterstützung durch erfahrene Expertinnen und Experten.

Was macht es besonders, für uns zu arbeiten?

Bei uns gleicht kein Tag dem anderen – Langeweile gibt es nicht.

Du und deine Kolleg*innen werdet mit Blick auf eure Stärken individuell gefördert. Wir legen Wert auf Weiterbildungen und fördern den teamübergreifenden Wissenstransfer durch unsere Expertenteams. Zudem sind nahbare Führungskräfte und gezieltes Performance Management wichtige Bestandteile unserer Kultur.

Teamwork makes the dream work – ist ja klar, oder?

Jedes Teammitglied erfüllt eine wichtige Aufgabe, ohne die im Ganzen etwas fehlen würde. Wir sind uns sicher, dass diese Wertschätzung motiviert. Nicht ohne Grund sind wir alle mit Freude und Leidenschaft bei der Sache und erreichen dadurch Spitzenleistungen.

Individualität macht uns aus: Teamwork ist uns wichtig, trotzdem verschwindet hier niemand in der Masse.

Arbeiten mit Wohlfühl-Faktor

Den itesys-Spirit haben wir ja schon erwähnt. Teamausflüge, gemeinsame Grillabende oder Office Brunch – wir finden immer einen Anlass zusammenzukommen. Bei uns muss niemand zum Lachen in den Keller gehen: in den Pausen herrscht eine lockere ausgelassene Atmosphäre bei dem alle willkommen sind. Beim Arbeiten kannst du jederzeit auf die Hilfsbereitschaft deiner Kolleg*innen zählen und musst dich nicht davor scheuen, Fragen zu stellen.

Wir freuen uns darauf dich kennenzulernen!

Seit 2012 stehen wir als Schweizer Dienstleister für verlässliche SAP-Landschaften und fundierte Betriebserfahrung. In dieser Rolle verantworten Sie den Betrieb, den Unterhalt und die Weiterentwicklung unserer Rechenzentren, Netzwerke und Firewall-Infrastrukturen. Sie analysieren komplexe Netzwerkstrukturen, optimieren die Performance unserer Systeme und sorgen für eine reibungslose und sichere Datenkommunikation im hybriden Arbeitsumfeld an unserem Standort in Frauenfeld.

Automation Engineer - GMP Pharma & Biotech

agap2 is a European engineering and operational consulting group founded in 2005 and specialized in the industry. We work in the Pharma, Biotechnology, Medical Devices, Energy, Infrastructure, Transportation, Chemicals, and Information Technology sectors.

As a consultant, you will have to support our clients in the realization of their projects on site by bringing your expertise and your skills.

You are agile and eager to adapt to different work environments that will fuel your curiosity of seeing what’s behind closed doors of the biggest projects of our client’s portfolio.

Tasks

You will work on the design, implementation, qualification and improvement of automation systems in GMP-regulated environments. Depending on your background, your expertise may focus on PLC, SCADA, HMI, DCS, MES or industrial networks.

You will collaborate with engineering, production, quality and validation teams on complex investment and improvement projects.

Your responsibilities

  • Design, develop and implement automation solutions in GMP environments.
  • Contribute to the configuration and programming of PLC, HMI, SCADA, DCS or MES systems.
  • Support FAT, SAT, commissioning, qualification and validation activities.
  • Troubleshoot automation, control and communication issues.
  • Develop and improve automation standards, procedures and technical documentation.
  • Support batch control, recipe management, data integrity and process monitoring activities.
  • Coordinate with multidisciplinary teams, suppliers and client stakeholders.
  • Contribute to the delivery of strategic pharmaceutical and biotech projects.

Requirements

  • Degree in Automation, Electrical Engineering, Industrial IT or a related field.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in a GMP-regulated pharmaceutical, biotechnology or life science environment.
  • Professional experience with at least one of the following: PLC, SCADA, HMI, DCS, MES, industrial automation or OT networks.
  • Knowledge of automation systems and industrial communication technologies.Experience with one or more platforms such as Siemens, Rockwell/Allen-Bradley, Emerson DeltaV or Syncade is an advantage.
  • Understanding of GMP, GAMP 5, data integrity and qualification/validation principles.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a consulting and project-based environment.
  • Good communication skills in English; German is a strong advantage.

Joining a group with strong development potential that aims to improve your employability on challenging and varied projects

  • Joining a structure that has been established in Switzerland for a long time with a client portfolio that includes leaders in the sector
  • Having a sustainable job with stability and access to a real collaboration

Only applications from Swiss and EU citizens will be considered.

jobs.title: Projectontwikkelaar vastgoed
jobs.description:
Projectontwikkelaar vastgoed

Wil jij bouwen aan de woningbouwopgave én aan een nieuwe ontwikkelorganisatie? Als Senior Projectontwikkelaar bij Dura Vermeer Bouw & Vastgoed werk je aan grootschalige vastgoedprojecten in Midden-Nederland. Je stapt in na tendergunning en bent verantwoordelijk voor de verdere ontwikkeling richting realisatie. In een ondernemende omgeving krijg je alle ruimte om mee te bouwen aan het team, je expertise in te zetten in de samenwerking met bouwpartners én door te groeien naar een rol met meer inhoudelijke en coachende verantwoordelijkheid.

 

Dit wordt jouw baan

Ondernemend, ervaren en klaar om impact te maken? Dan voel jij je thuis binnen deze nieuwe ontwikkelorganisatie van Dura Vermeer. Als Senior Projectontwikkelaar werk je aan omvangrijke vastgoedprojecten en help je niet alleen projecten verder te brengen, maar ook het team en de organisatie. Je begrijpt hoe ontwikkeling en bouw elkaar versterken, neemt eigenaarschap en krijgt de ruimte om mee te denken, mee te bouwen en mee te groeien. Je bent betrokken vanaf de fase na tendergunning en schakelt intensief met de bouw om projecten succesvol richting uitvoering te brengen. Daarnaast krijg je de mogelijkheid om in de toekomst ontwikkelaars te begeleiden en bijvoorbeeld door te groeien naar een rol als Hoofd Vastgoedontwikkeling.

 

Wat ga je doen

Deze functie richt zich nadrukkelijk niet op de initiatieffase of acquisitiekant van gebieds- en vastgoedontwikkeling. De focus ligt op het moment waarop een tender is gewonnen en projecten daadwerkelijk gerealiseerd gaan worden. Je werkt aan (midel)grote woningbouwontwikkelingen van honderden woningen en bent de verbindende factor tussen ontwikkeling en bouw. Dat maakt deze rol ideaal voor een ervaren ontwikkelaar die energie krijgt van het realiseren van projecten, ondernemerschap toont en wil meegroeien met een ambitieuze organisatie.

·       Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de ontwikkeling van woningbouwprojecten vanaf tendergunning tot aan de start van de realisatie;

·       Je stuurt het ontwikkelproces aan op het gebied van kwaliteit, planning, financiën en risico's;

·       Je verbindt de belangen van gemeenten, adviseurs, beleggers, corporaties, bouwteams en andere stakeholders;

·       Je werkt intensief samen met collega's van Bouw om projecten optimaal uitvoerbaar en haalbaar te maken;

·       Je vertaalt ambities en plannen naar concrete ontwikkelbeslissingen die bijdragen aan een succesvolle uitvoering;

·       Je voert regie op vergunningstrajecten, overeenkomsten en besluitvorming;

·       Je draagt actief bij aan de verdere opbouw en professionalisering van de ontwikkelorganisatie;

·       Je begeleidt en coacht minder ervaren projectontwikkelaars en krijgt de ruimte om op termijn een meer aansturende rol te vervullen.

Meer bij Dura Vermeer

Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en lange termijn visie vormen daarbij de basis.

Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent iconisch én dichtbij en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken.

Onze ambities zijn groot. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer maakt.


Hier zit je op jouw plek

Bij Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Utrecht staan we aan het begin van een nieuw hoofdstuk. Waar we jarenlang bekend stonden als een sterke renovatie/transformatiespecialist, zijn we sinds begin dit jaar uitgegroeid tot een volwaardige Bouw en Vastgoed organisatie. Naast renovatie en transformatie realiseren we nu ook nieuwbouwprojecten in de woning- en utiliteitsbouw én zetten we de volgende stap naar eigen gebieds- en vastgoedontwikkeling.

Dat betekent dat je terechtkomt in een organisatie die volop in beweging is. Met ruim 100 collega's binnen onze werkmaatschappij bouwen we niet alleen aan duurzame woningen, utiliteitsprojecten en leefomgevingen, maar ook aan de toekomst van onze eigen organisatie. De lijnen zijn kort, de ambities groot en de kansen om mee te bouwen aan nieuwe werkwijzen, teams en projecten liggen voor het oprapen.

Hier krijg je de ruimte om impact te maken. Niet vanaf de zijlijn, maar midden in een frisse organisatie die zich verder ontwikkelt en waarin ondernemerschap, samenwerking en eigenaarschap centraal staan. Samen bouwen we aan projecten waar we trots op zijn én aan een organisatie die klaar is voor de toekomst.


Dit breng jij mee

·       Minimaal 5 tot 10 jaar ervaring als projectontwikkelaar, ontwikkelmanager of vergelijkbare functie;

·       Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding;

·       Inzicht in bouwtechnische uitgangspunten om adviseurs aan te sturen en het plan verder uit te werken; 

·       Ervaring binnen een ontwikkelaar, ontwikkelende bouwer of vastgoedorganisatie.

Je bent een ontwikkelaar die vooral energie krijgt van de projecten na tendergunning verder te brengen richting realisatie. Je begrijpt de dynamiek van de bouw en weet hoe je samen met alle betrokken partijen woningbouwprojecten succesvol kunt ontwikkelen én realiseren.

Dit bieden wij jou

jobs.title: Senior HR Medewerker (m/v/x)
jobs.description:
Senior HR Medewerker (m/v/x)

Een ervaren HR-professional die graag complexe HR-vraagstukken oppakt, kennis deelt, overzicht houdt en bijdraagt aan een goede HR-dienstverlening.

Voor onze volop in beweging zijnde HR-afdeling en administratie/HR-support team zoeken we een ervaren HR-professional die goed thuis is in HR-processen, toepassing van arbeidsvoorwaarden en graag meedenkt over uiteenlopende HR-vraagstukken. Je bent een inhoudelijke vraagbaak voor collega’s en steekt zelf graag de handen uit de mouwen. Met een proactieve blik kijk je verder dan de dagelijkse praktijk en zie je kansen om processen te verbeteren. Herken jij jezelf hierin en bouw je graag mee aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze afdeling? Solliciteer dan snel!

Wat ga je doen?

Jij zorgt er samen met je hr-collega’s voor dat de basis van onze HR-administratie op orde is, maar jouw meerwaarde zit vooral in het behandelen van complexere operationele HR-vraagstukken, het ondersteunen van HR collega’s en het samen met de teamleider verder ontwikkelen van onze dienstverlening. Je bent een inhoudelijke vraagbaak voor het HR-team en een vertrouwd aanspreekpunt voor NLR medewerkers en HR-adviseurs.

Als senior HR-medewerker heb je een veelzijdige rol waarin HR-administratie, dienstverlening, inhoudelijke expertise en procesverbetering samenkomen. Jouw HR collega’s houden zich bezig met de dagelijkse HR-processen, waarbij jij je richt op vooral vraagstukken die meer ervaring, inzicht en zelfstandigheid vragen. Daarnaast deel je actief je kennis met collega's, denk je mee over een slimme verdeling van het werk en draag je bij aan de kwaliteit van onze dienstverlening.

Jouw werkzaamheden in het kort:

  • Vraagbaak voor het HR-team: je behandelt tweedelijns HR-vraagstukken over bijvoorbeeld arbeidsvoorwaarden, personeelsregelingen en HR processen, detachering, inleen en deelt je kennis en ondersteunt collega’s.

  • Samenwerken met de teamleider: je werkt aan HR-projecten, verbetert processen en bewaakt de voortgang, met name bij piekmomenten.

  • Ondersteunen van de HR Adviseurs en managers: je helpt bij operationele HR-vraagstukken en zorgt voor een goede aansluiting tussen HR-processen en de praktijk.

  • Zorgen voor goede HR-dienstverlening: je bewaakt de kwaliteit van de HR-administratie en hebt contact met medewerkers. Je draagt bij aan een juiste en tijdige verwerking van personeelsgegevens en ondersteunt waar nodig bij eerstelijnsvragen.

  • Bouwen aan de HR-afdeling: je signaleert knelpunten, denkt mee over praktische verbeteringen, helpt werkprocessen te uniformeren en deelt je kennis met collega's.

Wat breng je mee?

We zoeken iemand die senioriteit laat zien in zowel gedrag als HR-kennis. Je hoeft niet alles te weten, maar je hebt een stevige basis, durft verantwoordelijkheid te nemen en weet wanneer je zelfstandig kunt handelen en wanneer afstemming nodig is. First time right is het devies, kwalitatieve en zorgvuldige HR administratie en dienstverlening vinden wij belangrijk.

  • Afgeronde opleiding in HRM of een vergelijkbare richting met minimaal vijf jaar relevante ervaring binnen HR, bij voorkeur in een brede HR-administratieve functie en kennis van AFAS.

  • Je hebt gedegen kennis van HR-processen en ervaring met het zelfstandig behandelen van HR-vraagstukken over arbeidsvoorwaarden, personeelsregelingen en HR administratie.

  • Je bent communicatief sterk, toegankelijk en klantgericht. Je maakt gemakkelijk contact met medewerkers en collega’s op verschillende niveaus.

  • Je werkt graag samen, durft je eigen perspectief in te brengen en staat open voor feedback en andere inzichten.

  • Je werkt nauwkeurig, hebt oog voor details en houdt overzicht en helpt collega’s om werkzaamheden goed en tijdig af te ronden.

  • Je bent gewend en krijgt er energie van om in een snel groeiende en veranderende organisatie te werken.

  • Je beheerst het Nederlands en Engels goed, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk op C1 niveau.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Bij NLR krijg je de ruimte om impact te maken én jezelf te ontwikkelen. Je werkt in een innovatieve nationale en internationale hightechomgeving waar nieuwsgierigheid, samenwerking en vakmanschap centraal staan. We geloven dat mensen het beste presteren als ze de vrijheid krijgen om initiatief te nemen, zich te blijven ontwikkelen en een gezonde balans te vinden tussen werk en privé.

Verder bieden we je onder andere:

  • Een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 4400,- en € 5000 (op basis van een 40-urige werkweek), afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring;

  • 45 verlofdagen (op basis van een 40-urige werkweek);

  • 8% vakantiegeld én een vaste eindejaarsuitkering van 8%;

  • De kosten voor reizen met het openbaar vervoer worden volledig vergoed. Reis je met eigen vervoer? Dan ontvang je een kilometervergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer.

  • Een zorgtoelage van €145,- bruto (op basis van een 40-urige werkweek) via onze collectieve zorgverzekering bij OHRA als extra ondersteuning voor jouw zorgkosten;

  • Extra betaald ouderschapsverlof;

  • Volop kansen om te blijven leren met opleidingen, trainingen, coaching en andere ontwikkelmogelijkheden;

  • De mogelijkheid om 32-40 uur per week te werken inclusief thuiswerken.

Jouw nieuwe werkomgeving

Je wordt onderdeel van een breed HR-team met verschillende expertises, van HR-advies en beleid tot recruitment en Learning & Development. We sparren graag met elkaar, houden elkaar scherp en inspireren elkaar om verder te komen. Er is volop ruimte voor jouw ideeën, kennis en initiatief, met oog voor elkaar en het gezamenlijke resultaat. Samen werken we aan HR-dienstverlening die aansluit bij de behoeften van de organisatie en bijdraagt aan onze strategische ambities.

Onze HR-afdeling is volop in ontwikkeling en werkt aan verdere professionalisering en verbetering van processen en samenwerking. Dat biedt kansen, maar vraagt ook iets van jou. Je komt terecht in een HR-afdeling waar we volop werken aan het verbeteren van onze dienstverlening. We brengen meer structuur aan, maken onze processen eenvoudiger en werken steeds nauwer samen. Dat betekent dat niet alles al vastligt en dat er ruimte is om mee te denken en dingen slimmer te organiseren. Je standplaats is Amsterdam of Marknesse, maar je bent ook regelmatig op onze andere locatie voor overleg en samenwerking met collega’s.

Wat betekent werken bij NLR?

Koninklijke NLR is al meer dan 100 jaar een toonaangevende kennisinstelling voor toegepast onderzoek in de lucht- en ruimtevaart. Samen met meer dan 1000 professionals werken we aan innovatieve oplossingen voor een duurzamere, veiligere en efficiëntere lucht- en ruimtevaart. We willen dat iedereen bij NLR de ruimte krijgt om zichzelf te zijn, talenten te ontwikkelen en ideeën in te brengen. Door verschillen te waarderen en van elkaar te leren, creëren we samen een inclusieve werkomgeving.

Wil jij meer weten?

Mail dan met Christel Bouwers (Recruiter) via Onze collega’s vertellen jou graag hoe het is om bij NLR te werken. Vergeet trouwens ook niet eens een kijkje op onze socials te nemen zoals ons YouTube kanaal.

Solliciteren?

Mooi, we zijn benieuwd naar jou! Stuur je motivatiebrief en CV via de ‘Solliciteren’ button.

 

Een positieve uitkomst van een veiligheidsonderzoek (VGB) is een voorwaarde voor indiensttreding. Meer informatie daarover lees je op de website van de MIVD.

Acquisitie wordt niet op prijs gesteld!

Senior Customs & Trade Consultant

Internationale handel wordt steeds complexer. Veranderende douanewetgeving, geopolitieke ontwikkelingen, strengere compliance-eisen en digitalisering stellen organisaties voor nieuwe uitdagingen. Tegelijkertijd ontstaan kansen om handelsstromen slimmer, efficiënter en kosten-effectiever in te richten.

Als Senior Customs & Trade Consultant bij Customs Support Group help jij organisaties om die uitdagingen om te zetten in concrete oplossingen. Je combineert diepgaande kennis van douane en internationale handel met strategisch inzicht, commercieel gevoel en de ambitie om daadwerkelijk impact te maken. Je adviseert nationale en internationale ondernemingen, leidt uitdagende consultancyprojecten en ontwikkelt samen met klanten innovatieve oplossingen. Geen traditionele adviesrol, maar een positie waarin inhoudelijke expertise, ondernemerschap en daadwerkelijke implementatie samenkomen.

Wat ga je doen?

Je bent een vertrouwd adviseur voor klanten, variërend van ambitieuze mkb-organisaties tot internationale multinationals. Je beweegt je gemakkelijk tussen complexe douanevraagstukken, strategische besluitvorming en operationele verbeteringen. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

  • Strategisch douaneadvies: adviseren over internationale handelsstructuren, douaneregelingen, tariefindeling, oorsprong, douanewaarde en optimalisatie van douanekosten.

  • Customs & Trade Compliance: begeleiden van organisaties bij AEO, vergunningen, interne beheersing, risicomanagement en naleving van internationale handelswetgeving.

  • Business Transformation: analyseren en verbeteren van douaneprocessen, governance en internationale supplychains, waarbij je regelgeving vertaalt naar praktische oplossingen.

  • Digitalisering & Innovatie: adviseren over de inzet van technologie, data, automatisering en AI binnen douane- en handelsprocessen.

Je bent een ervaren douaneprofessional die inhoudelijke diepgang combineert met strategisch en commercieel inzicht. Je hebt een stevige professionele basis en bent toe aan een rol met meer verantwoordelijkheid, zelfstandigheid en invloed.

Wat breng je mee?

  • HBO- of WO-werk- en denkniveau, bijvoorbeeld in fiscaal recht, fiscale economie, bedrijfskunde, logistiek of internationale handel.

  • Ruime ervaring binnen customs consultancy, internationale handel, de Douane, het bedrijfsleven of een vergelijkbare adviesomgeving.

  • Diepgaande kennis van Europese douanewetgeving en relevante ontwikkelingen binnen internationale handel.

  • Ervaring met het zelfstandig adviseren van klanten en het leiden van complexe projecten.

  • Sterke analytische vaardigheden en het vermogen om juridische en operationele vraagstukken te vertalen naar strategische adviezen.

  • Een ondernemende instelling en gevoel voor commerciële kansen.

  • Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden in Nederlands en Engels.

Belangrijker dan een specifiek carrièrepad vinden wij jouw expertise, professionele volwassenheid en vermogen om klanten verder te helpen.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Wij bieden een seniorpositie met veel zelfstandigheid, inhoudelijke uitdaging en uitstekende arbeidsvoorwaarden.

  • Salaris van € 5.500 tot € 8.000 bruto per maand, afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring.

  • Aantrekkelijke variabele bonusregeling gekoppeld aan prestaties en resultaten.

  • 25 vakantiedagen, met mogelijkheden om aanvullende dagen op te bouwen.

  • 8,33% vakantiegeld.

  • Uitstekende pensioenregeling, met slechts 4,5% eigen bijdrage.

  • € 50 netto per maand well-being budget.

  • Hybride werken.

  • Moderne IT- en thuiswerkvoorzieningen.

  • Uitgebreide opleidingsmogelijkheden en toegang tot onze Customs Support Academy.

  • Nationale en internationale ontwikkel- en doorgroeimogelijkheden.

  • Een professioneel, betrokken en specialistisch team waarin kennisdeling en samenwerking centraal staan.

Over Customs Support Group

Customs Support Group is een toonaangevende Europese dienstverlener op het gebied van Customs & Trade Solutions. Met meer dan 1.700 professionals in 16 landen ondersteunen wij organisaties bij het beheersen en optimaliseren van internationale handelsstromen.

Wij combineren specialistische kennis, operationele dienstverlening en digitale innovatie om klanten te helpen hun internationale handelsactiviteiten compliant, efficiënt en toekomstbestendig in te richten.

Waarom kiezen voor Customs Support Group?

Inhoudelijke expertise staat centraal

Bij ons is Customs & Trade geen onderdeel van een brede adviespraktijk. Het is onze kernactiviteit. Je werkt dagelijks samen met professionals die jouw vakgebied begrijpen en dezelfde passie voor internationale handel delen.

Advies én uitvoering

Wij combineren strategische consultancy met diepgaande operationele kennis en technologische oplossingen. Daardoor kun je klanten niet alleen adviseren over wat beter kan, maar ook bijdragen aan de daadwerkelijke verandering.

Customs Support Group is actief in 16 Europese landen en telt ruim 1.700 professionals. Je profiteert van een internationaal netwerk, toegang tot uiteenlopende klanten en mogelijkheden om aan grensoverschrijdende projecten te werken.

Je krijgt de ruimte om je eigen adviestrajecten vorm te geven, klantrelaties te ontwikkelen en bij te dragen aan de verdere groei van onze consultancypraktijk.

Meebouwen aan de toekomst

De douanewereld verandert door digitalisering, automatisering, AI en nieuwe Europese wetgeving. Bij Customs Support krijg je de mogelijkheid om deze ontwikkelingen niet alleen te volgen, maar actief mee vorm te geven.

jobs.title: Product Manager – Traffic (Flow, Jams, Speed Profiles & Moderation)
jobs.description:
Product Manager – Traffic (Flow, Jams, Speed Profiles & Moderation)
Introduction
Real-time traffic is at the heart of TomTom's mission to engineer the smartest, most useful map on the planet. Our live and historical traffic products — flow, jams, and speed profiles — power navigation, ADAS, and mobility decisions for the world's leading automotive OEMs, enterprises, and ride-hailing companies. As these customers move faster and expect richer, more accurate content, the way we generate, moderate, and deliver traffic data becomes a decisive competitive advantage.
As Product Manager for Traffic Flow, Jams, and Speed Profiles, you will own a core part of TomTom's real-time traffic portfolio and set its multi-year roadmap, grounded in a deep understanding of traffic processing technology and customer needs. You will also own TomTom's traffic moderation tool — enabling the world's leading ride-hailing companies to submit event reports, such as closures — running its user operations and prioritizing its feature roadmap.

What you'll do
  • Own and deliver against Traffic Flow, Traffic Jams, and Speed Profiles — setting the roadmap, OKRs, and quality bar, and taking a leading role in product quality.
  • Own and operate TomTom's traffic moderation tool, enabling the world's leading ride-hailing companies to submit event reports such as closures; run user operations and prioritize the tool's feature backlog.
  • Bring a deep understanding of real-time traffic processing and jam detection, and use it to manage tradeoffs effectively.
  • Focus on outcomes over outputs, tracking metrics such as ETT accuracy, jam detection quality, traffic coverage, and speed profile coverage.
  • Lead brainstorms and drive product exploration through prototypes and wireframes.
  • Gather deep customer insights from automotive OEMs, government agencies, and enterprise clients, separating high-value initiatives from nice-to-haves.
  • Data acumen — able to analyze data from multiple sources, such as GPS traces, probes, STOs, camera observations, and traffic authorities, to drive decisions and assess tradeoffs.
  • Build strong cross-functional relationships and steer the product team by removing blockers and escalating appropriately.

jobs.title: ML Researcher
jobs.description:
ML Researcher

About Us

Base Compute is an AI inference lab. Our mission is to bring AGI on device. We believe in a world where everyone has access to intelligence: fast, private and always available on your device.

We’re building the infrastructure for the next generation of on-device AI, from silicon-level optimizations to distributed inference systems.

We’re working on hard problems at the intersection of inference efficiency, model intelligence and autonomous research.

The Role

We’re looking for a Founding ML Researcher to work at the frontier of on-device AI. This role is for someone who identifies problems and potentials, designs and executes experiments and derives insights that translate into real-world performance.

You’ll have significant ownership over our research agenda and direct influence on the technical bets the company makes.

What You’ll Work On

  • Inference research: Identifying and validating new approaches to on-device efficiency, including speculative decoding variants, novel quantization schemes and entirely new techniques yet to be discovered

  • Model routing research: Building the intelligence that decides how requests are served between on-device vs. frontier API models

  • Autoresearch pipelines: Designing systems that can autonomously explore, hypothesize and evaluate research ideas that accelerate our R&D loop

  • Evaluations and benchmarks: Developing rigorous evals that measure performance in the real world, outside of clean academic settings

What We’re Looking For

  • PhD in ML or equivalent industry research experience

  • Deep understanding of LLM architectures and the principles of AI inference

  • Expertise in a relevant topic, such as speculative decoding, quantization theory, model distillation, reinforcement learning

  • A track record of producing results that people build on: research papers, open-source projects or blog posts that prove out novel ideas

  • Good communication: the ability to explain complex ideas simply, give honest feedback and document findings in a reproducible way

  • Nice-to-haves:

    • Familiarity with GPU and accelerator architectures and kernel optimization (CUDA, ROCm, Metal, Triton, etc.)

    • Experience deploying models under on-device constraints (memory bandwidth, latency budgets, and thermal and power ceilings)

What We Offer

  • Equity and strong base salary

  • Direct influence on technical direction: your ideas will shape the roadmap

  • Work on genuinely hard problems that haven't been solved yet

  • Small team, fast iteration, low bureaucracy

Location

The team is based in Melbourne and Berlin and works in-person from the office most days. We require strong written and spoken English, since the team collaborates across time zones.

jobs.title: Head of Finance (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Head of Finance (m/f/d)

Your mission

About L1VE

L1VE is a growing media and technology company with locations in Berlin and New York. With immersive 14K, 3D and 360° streaming technologies and innovative live formats, L1VE is transforming the way people experience sports, music and entertainment.

As we continue to grow, we are looking for a full-time Head of Finance to join us as soon as possible. In this role, you will take overall responsibility for the further development of our finance function in Germany and Europe and create the financial structures and decision-making foundations for L1VE’s next phase of growth.

Your Role

As Head of Finance, you will act as a strategic partner to our CFO in New York and the executive team. You will translate the overarching finance strategy into scalable finance, controlling and reporting structures, as well as robust planning and management models.

You will combine strategic foresight with strong execution skills: you will develop financial models and scenarios, evaluate business models, investments, partnerships and growth options, and make opportunities, risks and economic implications transparent to management.

In this role, you will work closely with the CFO, the executive team, functional departments and internal and external finance partners. A particular focus will be on international legal entity and intercompany structures, licensing and revenue-share models, as well as the further development of KPI, forecasting and reporting processes.

Your Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement L1VE’s finance architecture for Germany and Europe, with a focus on growth, profitability, transparency and international scalability
  • Own integrated financial planning, budgeting, business cases, financial models, forecasts and scenarios as a basis for strategic decision-making
  • Build and further develop relevant KPI systems for Technology, Commercial, Product, Marketing and Sales
  • Evaluate business models, investments, partnerships, licensing models and growth options, including their financial opportunities, risks and implications
  • Support financing rounds, investor readiness, due diligence and the preparation of strategic transactions in close coordination with the CFO
  • Manage and further develop management, investor and partner reporting based on reliable and auditable data and processes
  • Coordinate interfaces with Finance Administration, Accounting, Tax, Audit, Legal and other external finance partners
  • Further develop finance, reporting and governance structures, as well as the systems and processes supporting them

Your profile

  • At least seven years of relevant professional experience in finance, including several years in a strategically responsible finance role – ideally combining experience in a demanding consulting or Big Four environment with hands-on experience in a startup, scale-up or growth company
  • Experience building scalable finance structures and working with integrated financial planning, business planning, financial modelling, forecasting and management reporting
  • Strong knowledge of controlling, business performance management, governance, risk management and the evaluation of business models, investments and growth options
  • Understanding of German commercial, tax and corporate law requirements, as well as experience managing external professional advisors
  • Ideally, experience in the media, entertainment, sports rights, streaming, subscription or digital B2C environment, including licensing and revenue-share models
  • Experience with financing processes, investor reporting, due diligence or M&A is an advantage
  • Ability to structure complex financial topics clearly and act as a strategic sparring partner to the CFO, executive team and functional departments
  • Strong analytical and entrepreneurial thinking, a high degree of independence and a strong sense of ownership
  • Confident and practical use of AI tools in finance; you can demonstrate with specific examples which AI-supported solutions you have implemented and what additional value they created
  • Excellent written and spoken German and English, as well as confident use of finance, reporting and collaboration tools

Why us?

  • You will shape the financial foundations of the next growth phase of an internationally active media and technology company.
  • You will work closely with our CFO in New York and the executive team and have a direct strategic influence.
  • You will have significant room to shape your work, short decision-making paths and the opportunity to build structures and systems that create lasting value.

Interested?

Please send us your CV along with a short cover letter or a few sentences outlining your interest in L1VE and why you would be a strong fit for the Head of Finance role.
We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.title: Documentation Lead
jobs.description:
Documentation Lead

About Artificial

Help shape the future of specialty insurance

At Artificial, we’re building the next generation of technology for the specialty (re)insurance market. Our mission is to transform how brokers and carriers operate in complex markets by removing operational barriers and enabling smarter, faster decision-making.

We use modern technology to solve real challenges for some of the world’s leading brokers and insurers. By automating the repetitive and structuring the complex, we help our partners unlock new opportunities for innovation and growth.

You’ll be joining a collaborative team that values curiosity, ownership, and continuous learning. We work in an environment where ideas are heard, support is built-in, and outcomes matter. Everyone here has the chance to make a tangible impact on our products, our customers, and the industry.

We've just raised $45M (£33M) in Series B funding from lead investor CommerzVentures, new investor Move Capital, as well as all existing shareholders. This investment round gives us the room to grow with confidence, continue to innovate, and ensure that Artificial remains the first choice for brokers and carriers seeking a smarter way to trade digitally.

Join us, and take the chance to be a part of something that will change the landscape of insurance for generations.

About the role

At Artificial, there are three primary sources of documentation we maintain:

  1. Client-facing product documentation for insurance business users (brokers, underwriters and operations teams using our platform)

  2. Our internal documentation site, which is our most heavily used documentation surface, built docs-as-code from the engineering repository and authored largely by engineers.

  3. Our public API documentation, owned and authored by our Integrations team from auto-generated OpenAPI specifications.

The below responsibilities break down how each of these three sources are to be managed.

Responsibilities

  • Own the client-facing product documentation (1) end-to-end: strategy, information architecture, standards, tooling and content quality

  • Own the internal documentation gap backlog (2):

    • proactively identify potential gaps and triage incoming gap reports

    • route each one to the best-placed author and chase it to completion

    • write the content yourself where you're the right author

  • Steward the internal documentation site (2) and public API documentation (3): set the standards, information architecture and editorial bar for content authored by engineering and integrations teams, and keep the publishing pipelines healthy

  • Interview engineers about new features as they ship, and demystify them for non-technical readers before anyone has to ask

About Artificial

At Artificial, we’re building the next generation of technology for the specialty (re)insurance market. Our mission is to transform how brokers and carriers operate in complex markets by removing operational barriers and enabling smarter, faster decision-making.

We've just raised $45M (£33M) in Series B funding from lead investor CommerzVentures, new investor Move Capital, as well as all existing shareholders. This investment round gives us the room to grow with confidence, continue to innovate, and ensure that Artificial remains the first choice for brokers and carriers seeking a smarter way to trade digitally.

Join us, and take the chance to be a part of something that will change the landscape of insurance for generations.

About the role

Today, a key part of delivery has no clear owner: problem framing before configuration begins.

  • On the customer side, there are rarely UX specialists - only domain experts and sponsors who describe needs as pre-formed solutions.

  • On our side, configured workspaces are built by Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) in our Transform team: experts in the platform, accountable for shipping to a deadline, but not trained designers.

  • Our Platform teams have design expertise but are often too far removed from individual implementations to influence the moments that matter most.

The result is pretty predictable: we move quickly into “how” before we are confident about the “what” and “why.”

Your mandate is to slow down at the right moment and make sure we’re solving the right problem - then help the team implement the best platform-valid solution.

This is a founding role. You would be the first Forward Deployed Designer (FDD) at Artificial, hired into an enabling function within the Platform team, with the mandate to define how the function works and to build it out. Later, FDDs would join the Transform teams in hands-on client roles: you’d take part in hiring them (with our support), then line-manage them directly.

Responsibilities

You would work closely with the Transform team and customers throughout discovery and delivery. In practice, that means:

  • Establish the FDD function. Define the operating model, the patterns, and the ways of working from scratch.

  • Grow and manage the team. Take part in hiring subsequent FDDs and line-manage them as they join.

  • Join customer + FDE sessions early (problem framing and discovery), not only at reviews once decisions are already fixed.

  • Translate requests into problems. For example, turn “we need a confirmation button before this step” into:

    • the user behaviour driving the request

    • two or three platform-valid approaches

    • a recommendation, with trade-offs explained

  • Prototype and test ideas quickly using the most effective medium (written specs, wireframes, workflows, or light code). We care more about clarity and platform realism than polished artefacts.

  • Provide credible pushback when the customer’s proposed solution doesn’t address the underlying problem.

  • Codify patterns and precedents so knowledge moves from individual memory into shared team infrastructure.

  • Level up the FDE team’s design instincts over time. You shouldn’t be the only person who can think about UX across the two teams; part of the job is coaching, so the capability can spread.

  • Use workspace signals (e.g. session data and call analysis) to surface risks early - before they become escalations.

About you

You are a designer who thrives in ambiguity and constraints, someone who can bring structure, judgement, and clarity to complex, real-world delivery.

You likely have experience in enterprise/B2B software where:

  • the design system already exists

  • the hard part is framing the right problem and navigating stakeholders

  • solutions must work within meaningful technical and organisational constraints

You understand technical concepts fluently. Part of the role would involve writing code (with plenty of LLM and human assistance) using our in-house DSL (Domain Specific Language). We don’t want you to be an engineer, but we do need you to be comfortable reading and writing some code, reasoning about how a configurable system behaves, and understanding what the platform can and can’t express, well enough to hold a credible conversation with engineers and to explain these constraints to customers when necessary.

You have managed designers. You’re comfortable with line management of a small team (roughly three to five people) and have hired designers before. Early on, you’d do this hands-on yourself; as the function grows, you’d manage the FDDs who follow.

jobs.title: Product Integration Engineer, Defence
jobs.description:
Product Integration Engineer, Defence

We're looking for a Product Integration Engineer to develop and prove out our products with military customers, starting with the Field Operator HUD (FOH): a head-mounted, always-on visual intelligence system built from Distance hardware, a HUD operating system and AI-assisted data processing that pulls sensor, feeds and command-and-control into the operator's field of view. Your job is to make it work on a specific customer's platform, in the field, not just on a bench, as part of our core R&D team. If you're a hands-on generalist who knows VR or XR and would rather be where the tech meets the user than stuck at a desk, this one's for you.

WHY DISTANCE?

At Distance Technologies, the problem we're solving is simple to state and hard to solve: the amount of data in the world is endless, but human capacity is not. We are building a fundamentally new perception layer between humans and machines, transforming transparent surfaces into interfaces unlike the world has ever seen. Think of the windscreen of a car, the visor of a helmet, or a sight device, each becoming a new front-end for AI. The way we turn bits and atoms into expanded human perception is protected by over 50 granted international patent families. We build it for two demanding worlds: defence and automotive. And we build it from a single foundation fusing software, hardware and computational optics.

There are 60 of us today, with decades-long experience building world's best products, optics, and open-source operating systems. We partner and build with globally leading companies like KIA, Supacat, and Galvion, and we were Google Ventures' first investment in Finland.

THE ROLE

The FOH is already in field trials with military users. Your first project is getting it working with British Army equipment and defence primes, building the integration around what the customer actually needs. As our product line grows you'll take on a widening set of customer integrations across our defence work, each one a different platform, stack and set of interfaces.

Your core responsibilities include:

  • Owning customer integrations end to end. Make the FOH work inside a customer's platform: adapt the software, wire it into their sensors, displays, video and connectivity, and get it demo- and trial-ready. Prototype fast in dedicated environments to prove value with a client before it hits the shared codebase.

  • Being Distance in the field. Join demos, trials and exercises with defence clients, support on-site deployments when needed, and bring back what you see and hear on real kit.

  • Bridging the field and the core. Turn what customers need into concrete integration work with the R&D and commercial teams, spot what should become shared product capability, and feed it into the roadmap and, eventually, the shared codebase.

You won't be a satellite. You'll join the software standups and reviews and be a real part of R&D.

WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU

  • Your work ships and gets used. What you integrate goes into real kit already in trials with military users, and what you learn from demos, trials and exercises with them feeds straight back into the product.

  • You own the whole thread. From first prototype to working integration in the field, it's yours, not passed between five teams.

  • New display tech. Glasses-free computational optics and a see-through HUD, the kind of problem you won't find at most XR jobs.

  • A small team backed to move fast. Around 60 of us, Google Ventures' first investment in Finland, and flat enough that your calls count.

OUR EXPECTATIONS

What we're looking for:

  • A builder, not a passenger: a hands-on self-starter who takes ownership, works things out when docs are missing, and would rather be with a customer or in the field than at a desk.

  • At least a couple of years of software engineering experience with VR or XR, plus generalist instincts.

  • Comfort across a mixed software stack. You've worked with some of C++, Unity and embedded, and you pick up the rest quickly.

  • Some exposure to electrical integration or software-to-hardware interfaces. We're not expecting deep hardware experience on top of strong software.

  • You're at home in prototype and integration work: incomplete docs, customer-specific stacks, messy interfaces.

  • Good with clients, and happy to be the person representing Distance at a demo or trial.

  • Willing to travel within the UK when needed, and to Finland now and then.

It's a bonus, though not required, if you've worked with HMDs, wearable displays or spatial computing, know C++ for integration and application development, can stand up a UI or application stack for quick situational-awareness or demo prototypes, are comfortable with embedded or Linux at integration level, or have seen sensor, display and video interfaces at system level.

You'll be based within commuting distance of the Bath office and in the office two to three days a week. Our working language is English.

DID WE GET YOU INTERESTED?

Directeur des opérations Datacenter (H/F)

Head of DC Operations (H/F)

Région parisienne

Votre mission

Dans un environnement où la disponibilité et la fiabilité des infrastructures sont essentielles, Isatalent recherche un(e) Head of DC Operations pour piloter les opérations de ses data centers en région parisienne.

Rattaché(e) à la direction, vous êtes garant(e) de la performance opérationnelle, de la continuité de service et de la fiabilité des infrastructures. Vous encadrez les responsables de site et travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes d'expertise centrales, les clients et les partenaires de maintenance.

Dans un contexte de croissance de l'entreprise et d'exigences opérationnelles, vous jouez un rôle clé dans l'harmonisation des pratiques, la structuration du pilotage des activités et l'accompagnement du changement auprès des équipes.

Votre objectif : construire une vision opérationnelle consolidée, maîtriser les risques et fédérer les équipes autour d'exigences communes de performance, de sécurité et de qualité de service.

Vos responsabilités

Piloter la stratégie et la performance des opérations multisites

  • Élaborer une feuille de route opérationnelle à court et moyen terme, en définissant les priorités, les plans d'action et les ressources humaines et financières nécessaires.

  • Définir et harmoniser les méthodes de pilotage des activités opérationnelles sur l'ensemble des sites.

  • Consolider et faire évoluer les KPI et tableaux de bord portant notamment sur la disponibilité des infrastructures, la maintenance, la communication client et le respect des procédures.

  • Analyser les résultats, identifier les écarts de performance et piloter les actions correctives.

  • Produire un reporting structuré à destination de la direction et éclairer les décisions stratégiques.

Manager les responsables de site et accompagner la transformation

  • Encadrer et accompagner les responsables de site dans le pilotage de leurs activités et le développement de leurs compétences.

  • Apporter une expertise opérationnelle et technique permettant de challenger les choix, les priorités et les plans d'action.

  • Favoriser l'autonomie, la responsabilisation et la coopération des équipes.

  • Organiser l'allocation des ressources et le suivi des plans de charge.

  • Accompagner la réorganisation du périmètre, harmoniser les pratiques et contribuer à l'intégration de nouveaux sites.

  • Travailler en transversalité avec le responsable du pôle Expertise et les autres fonctions de l'entreprise.

Garantir la fiabilité des infrastructures et maîtriser les risques

  • Garantir la disponibilité, la résilience et la continuité d'exploitation des infrastructures critiques.

  • Superviser la maintenance préventive, corrective et réglementaire, ainsi que les travaux, extensions, rétrofits et changements réalisés en environnement exploité.

  • Reprendre et consolider la cartographie des risques opérationnels et techniques, notamment les points uniques de défaillance (SPOF) et les obsolescences critiques.

  • Hiérarchiser les risques, définir les plans de traitement, en évaluer les impacts financiers et humains et identifier les investissements nécessaires.

  • Piloter les incidents majeurs, les escalades, les analyses de causes et le suivi des actions correctives et préventives.

  • Garantir le respect des exigences de sécurité, de conformité et de continuité de service.

Développer la relation client et le partenariat avec les mainteneurs

  • Garantir le respect des engagements contractuels, des SLA et des standards de qualité attendus par les clients.

  • Renforcer la qualité de la communication opérationnelle et la confiance avec les interlocuteurs clients.

  • Développer une relation constructive et partenariale avec les mainteneurs et les prestataires.

  • Améliorer la coordination des interventions, le suivi des engagements et la qualité des prestations.

  • Identifier les axes de progrès et piloter les actions d'amélioration de la performance des partenaires.

Piloter les budgets et l'amélioration continue

  • Élaborer et suivre les budgets OPEX et CAPEX du périmètre.

  • Arbitrer les priorités de maintenance, de renouvellement et d'investissement en fonction des risques, des capacités et des engagements clients.

  • Garantir le respect des exigences réglementaires, environnementales, HSE, ICPE et des référentiels ISO applicables.

  • Déployer des standards, procédures et méthodes de travail homogènes.

  • Contribuer à l'amélioration de la performance énergétique des installations, notamment du PUE, et à la maîtrise des coûts d'exploitation.

Votre profil

Formation et expérience

  • Formation supérieure, idéalement Bac +5, de type ingénieur ou master spécialisé en génie électrique, énergétique, climatique, maintenance industrielle ou management des opérations. Un Bac +3 technique pourra être étudié au regard d'une expérience particulièrement solide.

  • Expérience significative dans l'exploitation, la maintenance ou la direction technique d'infrastructures critiques.

  • Expérience significative en management de managers, en pilotage multisite ou dans une fonction de responsabilité opérationnelle comparable.

  • Expérience confirmée dans un environnement critique fonctionnant 24h/24 et 7j/7, avec de fortes exigences de disponibilité, de sécurité et de conformité.

  • Expérience en gestion d'incidents majeurs, pilotage de budgets, gestion des risques et conduite de transformations opérationnelles.

Compétences techniques

  • Bonne maîtrise des enjeux d'exploitation des data centers et compréhension des architectures électriques, mécaniques, CVC, de protection incendie, de GTB/BMS et des systèmes de contrôle.

  • Maîtrise du pilotage de la maintenance préventive, corrective et réglementaire.

  • Connaissance des SLA, KPI de disponibilité, capacité, qualité de service et performance énergétique.

  • Capacité à analyser et challenger les risques techniques, les plans de maintenance et les investissements.

  • Maîtrise des enjeux budgétaires OPEX/CAPEX et des exigences réglementaires applicables.

Qualités personnelles

  • Leadership et capacité à manager des responsables expérimentés.

  • Crédibilité technique et sens des responsabilités.

  • Capacité à structurer une organisation, harmoniser les pratiques et conduire le changement.

  • Aptitude à fédérer les équipes et à développer la coopération transverse.

  • Capacité de décision, d'arbitrage et de priorisation.

  • Sang-froid en situation de crise, rigueur et orientation résultats.

  • Sens du client et capacité à construire des relations de partenariat durables.

Langues : français courant et anglais professionnel, à l'oral comme à l'écrit.

Les enjeux de réussite

Au cours des premiers mois, vous aurez notamment pour objectifs de construire une feuille de route opérationnelle claire, de consolider le pilotage par les indicateurs, de hiérarchiser les risques et de définir les moyens nécessaires à leur traitement.

Vous contribuerez également à renforcer la cohésion managériale, à harmoniser les pratiques entre les sites et à accompagner l'évolution de l'organisation dans une logique durable de performance et d'amélioration continue.

Vous souhaitez mettre votre expertise des infrastructures critiques au service d'un environnement exigeant, avec une forte dimension managériale, stratégique et transverse ?

We believe the best results come from people who are curious, driven and passionate about what they do. That's why we give you the freedom to grow, the trust to shape your own path and the opportunity to make a real impact.

 

 How you’ll make your impact

 ITQ is growing fast in France. To keep up with this growth, we are strengthening our French sales team and are looking for a Sales Account Manager to join it. As Sales Account Manager at ITQ, you will work alongside experienced sales colleagues to build and develop ITQ's customer base in France, and help shape the further development of ITQ as an end-to-end service provider.

You are a team player with experience in selling IT services who enjoys working with enthusiastic and dynamic teams and colleagues in the ITQ Family.

 

What you’ll be doing 

  • Contribute to ITQ's growth in the French market as part of an established team of sales professionals, working together to cover the French territory.

  • From day one, you will build and manage customer opportunities in collaboration with your fellow Account Managers and the (inside) sales team. Over time you will build and sustain your own pipeline across new and existing customer accounts, based on the full breadth of ITQ services.

  • Within the team, you drive ITQ's commercial activities on your accounts, including sales of all ITQ services: professional, managed and support services, as well as software licenses and hardware resales.

  • Together with the sales team and stakeholders, you co-develop a sales strategy towards ITQ's revenue and profitability targets. You build and maintain partner relationships with other IT service providers in France.

  • You are a trusted advisor to our customers, understanding their "why" and helping them translate it into solutions and services that keep them one step ahead of their competition.

  • You create offers and service descriptions, pursue opportunities and close them. Accurate forecasting of license, service and other sales, and creating new customers in the CRM system, are familiar to you.

     

 Who you are 

  • You have a degree in business informatics, business administration or an apprenticeship as an IT systems clerk, or comparable training.

  • You have 3+ years of experience selling services, managed services, software licenses and hardware resales.

  • You are familiar with the VMware portfolio, the vendor, its partners and clients.

  • You are oriented towards mid-sized to large business accounts.

  • You are reliable, responsible and feel responsible for ITQ and our customers.

  • You have an independent, self-reliant and goal-oriented way of working, and you enjoy sharing and collaborating within a team.

  • You are versatile in all business development matters.

  • You have already successfully demonstrated your teamwork and organizational skills.

  • A community of experts: Join a team of passionate professionals who genuinely enjoy sharing knowledge, supporting one another and celebrating success together.

  • Mobility that works for you: Whether you prefer a lease car or a mobility budget, you'll have the flexibility to choose the option that best fits your lifestyle.

  • The right tools from day one: Choose your own laptop and phone with our budget equipment, delivered before you start. We also provide a home office budget to help you create your ideal workspace.

  • ITQlife: We organize activities throughout the year that bring colleagues together: from our traditional summer BBQ to our annual weekend and various team outings.

  • Your well-being matters: You’ll have access to a vitality coach, who can support you with your psychical and mental well-being.

  • And of course… we offer a solid foundation by offering a competitive salary, insurances and a pension plan.

jobs.title: Architecture Modeling Engineer
jobs.description:
Architecture Modeling Engineer

Meet Arago and the Aragonians

Arago’s mission is to re-engineer the foundations of computing from first principles.

The explosive growth of AI is pushing the industry to rethink how processors are built. Arago is meeting that challenge with a proprietary technology that fuses optical and CMOS technologies to deliver an order-of-magnitude increase in performance.

Arago is the fastest, and currently the only, company to have built such a processor. It's backed by leading deep-tech investors and some of the most respected figures in semiconductors and computing, including the CEO of Arm, the founder of macOS who worked directly with Steve Jobs at Apple, an Nvidia Fellow, the Head of Optics at Google, and many other industry leaders.

Our work is guided by three clear values: do great things, move with high velocity, and operate as one unit. We work in a demanding environment where constant learning, ownership, and execution are expected, and where exceptional people have the opportunity to do their life’s work.

 

What you’ll do

As Architecture Modeling Engineer you will own performance modeling and workload analysis for Arago's optical AI accelerator, working across hardware and software teams to evaluate design choices, shape the programming model, and optimize key compute kernels. This role turns workload requirements into architecture decisions and, ultimately, high-performance software on silicon.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Strong mathematical background, particularly in linear algebra, probability, numerical methods, and quantitative performance analysis.

  • Strong knowledge of computer architecture, including compute pipelines, memory hierarchies, interconnects, and parallel execution.

  • Strong C/C++ and Python programming skills.

  • Experience analyzing and optimizing performance-critical kernels or low-level compute workloads.

  • Good understanding of AI/ML workloads, tensor operations, data movement, and common execution patterns.

  • Ability to work across hardware and software teams and translate workload behavior into architecture and software requirements.

  • Language: English at a proficient level.

Responsibilities

  • Develop fast, flexible performance models to evaluate AI accelerator architecture choices and guide early design decisions.

  • Work closely with the software team to characterize key AI workloads, kernels, dataflows, and system bottlenecks.

  • Work closely with hardware architects to model compute, memory, interconnect, and scheduling behavior across proposed architectures.

  • Drive rapid performance studies and trade-off analyses across throughput, latency, utilization, bandwidth, and efficiency.

  • Help define and validate the programming model and workload mapping strategy for the accelerator.

  • Following architecture definition, work hands-on with the software team to optimize compute kernels and key workloads for the target hardware.

  • Build lightweight simulation, profiling, and analysis tools that support fast iteration from architecture exploration through software optimization.

Nice to have

  • Strong industry knowledge about AI hardware, GPUs, memory generations, rack-scale computing.

  • Experience building performance models, simulators, or analytical models for CPUs, GPUs, NPUs, or other accelerators.

  • Experience with profiling, benchmarking, and identifying hardware or software performance bottlenecks.

  • Experience in novel computing architectures: analog computing, in-memory computing, heterogeneous systems.

Pay and benefits

  • Competitive cash compensation, with final package based on location, experience, and the pay of team members in similar positions.

  • Meaningful stock option plan offered (included in the majority of full time offers).

  • Healthcare coverage (including family-friendly options), pension contributions, professional development support, and 25 days of PTO, in addition to public holidays.

  • Ownership of a key technical domain, with significant vertical and/or horizontal growth opportunities, based on performance and individual drive.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of AI at Arago.

You’ll split your time between building (ingestion pipelines, automation, tooling) and deploying and operating (working with customers to get Exeon running reliably in their environments), so your work shapes both scalability and customer success.

Exeon offers an open company culture that values and encourages diversity, teamwork and a growth mindset. Our goal is to provide our employees with an exciting, supportive and motivating environment for personal growth and career development while ensuring that our team maintains a healthy work-life balance. We strive to achieve this by offering:

jobs.description:
Systems Engineer (Excavator Automation)

Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots. 

Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment. 

Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry. 

The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously.  

 

 

About the Job

The autonomy team at Gravis builds autonomous systems for excavators operating in real construction environments. This role is at the intersection of system engineering, integration, field deployments, and debugging.

We are looking for an engineer with a degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or Robotics or relevant fields and at least 2 years of practical, hands-on experience working with real systems - and if they fail, you can help us figure out why. This is not an entry-level or new-graduate role.

You will help define and execute system-level test scenarios, support atypical and beta deployments, and act as a technical bridge between the field and the engineering team. You will help train our field engineers and keep them in touch with fast evolving autonomy capabilities.

What you will do

  • Validate system behavior across machines, environments, and operating conditions

  • Identify edge cases, failure modes, and operational limits

  • Collaborate with engineering teams on making technical decisions on a system level

  • Investigate system failure during field testing or deployments

  • Apply hotfixes when appropriate

  • Support or conduct deployments if needed, especially pilots or beta customers

  • Support/conduct atypical deployments, pilots, and beta customers

  • Capture lessons learned from deployments and feed them back into system testing and design

  • Help prioritize fixes and improvements based on real-world impact


    • What we're looking for

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, or a closely related field

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience working with complex systems (automation, robotics, vehicles, heavy machinery, industrial equipment, or similar)

  • Strong system-level troubleshooting and debugging skills

  • C++ and Python programming skills, proficiency in git systems

  • Proficiency in Linux systems

  • Comfortable working in field environments (construction sites, test yards, deployments)

  • Ability to travel abroad, according to needs of the business

  • Driver’s license B category


    • Beneficial

  • Experience with excavators, heavy equipment, or off-road vehicles

  • Field testing experience

  • Familiarity with communication technologies such as DDS, Zenoh, LCM etc.

  • Experience in motion planning or control

  • Experience in robotic competitions

    • Don't meet every requirement? If you're enthusiastic about this role but your experience doesn't match every qualification, we still encourage you to apply. You might be the perfect candidate for this or other positions.

About the Job

At Gravis, we build high tech systems that give machine operators superhuman capabilities. To adapt in real time to changes in the environment the Gravis Rack fuses data from LiDAR, cameras, GNSS, and hydraulics into an autonomous control system. The robotics platform team builds the software foundation for our robots to enable non stop operation in the harshest environments. We ensure all algorithms execute correctly, based on a rock solid communication layer and world class introspection capabilities. We provide all the tools to deploy, develop and debug the most powerful robots on earth.

As a robotics platform staff software engineer, you will help shape and implement our vision of a scalable, safe and high performing robotics platform. Meewerkstage Architectuur

Jij draagt bij aan de gebouwde omgeving van de toekomst.

  • Je werkt mee aan publieke projecten zoals stations, transferia, fietsenstallingen, bruggen en utiliteitsbouw (nieuwbouw en transformaties).

Tijdens deze stage architectuur draai je mee in het ontwerpproces van studioSK, het ontwerplabel van Movares. Samen met architecten en multidisciplinaire adviseurs werk je aan publieke projecten. Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. jobs.description:
Senior Product Engineer (Software) (m/w/d)

Roger is the operating system for dental practices. We automate the work dental teams shouldn’t be doing by hand – from treatment plans to patient communication to revenue optimization – and we plug directly into the practice management systems (PMS) that German practices already run on. We’re early, well-funded, and moving fast.

We’re looking for a Senior Product Engineer who wants to own a product area end to end: understand the practice’s problem, decide what to build, ship it, run it, and improve it with real usage data. Not tickets. Outcomes.

We call the role Product Engineer on purpose. You work directly with product, design, and practices, and you’re accountable for whether what you built actually solves the problem – not just for whether the code merged.

What you’ll build
Everyone works across the whole product; people build deeper expertise in some areas, but who works on what can change quickly. Over a typical quarter you’ll touch things like:
• PMS integrations – connecting Roger to the practice management systems German practices run on, so our workflows sit on top of live practice data instead of beside it
• Treatment plans and cost estimates (HKP) – turning a manual, error-prone paper process into something a practice team gets right the first time
• Patient communication – recalls, reminders, and follow-ups that practices today handle by phone, fax, and sticky note
• Revenue and billing workflows – helping practices bill what they actually did, correctly and on time
• The Roger apps – web and Flutter clients that practice staff use all day, every day

Whatever your area, you’ll own it from the first conversation with a practice to the dashboard that tells you whether it worked.

What we expect
• Own outcomes, not tasks. You define scope, timelines, and success criteria for your area, and you align stakeholders around them
• Make technical decisions and stand behind them. Architecture, trade-offs, what to build versus buy – you decide, document why, and course-correct when the data says so
• Know the system, not just your service. Roger is one product. You keep enough context across PMS integrations, data model, and clients to make decisions that hold up outside your corner
• Raise the bar continuously. Testing, documentation, CI/CD, observability – you leave every area better than you found it
• Shape how we work with AI. Our tooling and practices are still evolving. You contribute to them actively rather than waiting for a playbook
• Enable others. Code reviews, knowledge sharing, pairing – a senior here makes the people around them better

How we work
AI-native engineering, honestly described. Most of us run several coding agents in parallel, all day. Writing code is no longer the bottleneck. Reviewing it, testing it, and deciding what not to ship is. So here’s what that actually means for you:
• You write specs and plans before you prompt. Skipping design thinking is where projects fail – not the AI
• You review agent output with the same rigor as any PR. If you can’t explain what a module does, it doesn’t ship
• You test relentlessly. A solid test suite is how you turn an unreliable agent into a reliable system
• Your fundamentals are strong enough to evaluate, correct, and improve whatever AI produces – architecture, security, performance
• You know the spectrum: when a throwaway prototype is fine and when full engineering discipline applies
• You expect to spend as much time reviewing and validating as writing. If that sounds like a downgrade, this isn’t the right team. If it sounds like leverage, read on

Patient data is not a detail. Roger handles health data (GDPR Art. 9) and sits inside practices bound by professional secrecy (§ 203 StGB). Data minimization, access control, EU processing, and a clear head about what may go to which model provider are part of the engineering bar here – not a compliance checkbox someone else owns.
Small team, short paths. You talk to practices, to product, and to the people who answer the phones for our customers. Decisions get made in a conversation, not a committee.

Who you are
• Senior-level, with significant experience shipping and operating production systems – you’ve been paged for your own code
• A track record of owning projects end to end: from a vague problem statement through delivery to production and iteration
• Used to working cross-functionally with product, design, data, and non-technical stakeholders – and comfortable talking to end users directly
• You think beyond your own code: business context, user needs, and product goals shape what you build
• You take ownership without waiting for instructions, make decisions under ambiguity, and escalate when it matters
• You communicate openly and clearly, in writing and in person, with technical and non-technical people alike
• Our stack is Ruby on Rails, Go, and Dart/Flutter. Deep experience in at least one of these helps; strong fundamentals matter more than any specific language
• Bonus, not required: experience in healthcare, dental, or another regulated domain; or with integrating into legacy on-premise systems

Location, language, and setup
• Location: You live in Germany and can be in our Berlin office regularly. The role is hybrid: 2–3 days a week on site, the rest remote
• German: Business-fluent German (C1 or better) is required. You’ll talk to practices, read PMS vendor documentation, and work with German regulatory and billing concepts daily. Our team language is English
• Eligibility: You already hold the right to work in Germany.
• Working hours: Full-time

Why Roger?
• The opportunity is absurd. A market worth billions that still runs on fax machines and phone tag
• Real leverage. You’ll be one of 6 engineers. Your area is yours – your decisions shape the product, not a committee’s
• Hard, interesting problems in a space most tech companies ignore: legacy integrations, regulated data, real-world workflows with real-world stakes
• Engineers who care about craft. We argue about architecture, not politics
• Compensation: €75,000 – €95,000 base salary depending on experience, plus equity participation and benefits: Deutschlandticket, Urban Sports Club, 30 days’ vacation and Hrmony (50€ in-kind compensation).
